jobs.description:

**Job Description:**

**Position Summary**

As an **STC Electrical Systems Engineer,** you will be the technical lead for all electrical systems architecture and integration tasks across our Supplemental Type Certificate (STC) cabin upgrade projects. Operating under JAR25, CS25, and FAR25 airworthiness requirements, you will own the electrical package from end to end—translating initial customer requests into certified, installable wiring and system configurations for the hangar floor.

  

**Meet the team:**

Our Engineers have the privilege of working on complex, highly engineered machines and are involved at all stages of the aircraft life cycle, from product development to manufacturing and direct support to our airline customers. If you’re interested in designing, creating, and testing the present and future of Airbus products across the globe, join our mission to connect the world.

  

**Your working environment:**

The Engineering Center in Mobile, Alabama houses hundreds of Airbus engineers who assist in the design and development of Airbus commercial aircraft cabins, including aftermarket upgrades, reconfigurations and services of all product types across the globe.

  

**How we care for you:**

* Financial Rewards: Competitive base salary, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”)
* Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a generous paid parental leave program.
* Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical (traditional and high-deductible health plans), prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages.
Individual Development: Upskilling and development opportunities through our global Leadership University, including unlimited access to 10,000+ e-learning courses focusing on ways to develop your employability, certifications, career path as well as the opportunity to participate in accelerated development programmes and both national and international mobility.  

  

**Your challenges:**

* You will act as the technical anchor for the electrical systems team, ensuring all engineering packages are delivered on-time and on-quality.
* Architecture & Design: Define complex cabin electrical system architectures (block diagrams), author equipment specifications, and validate all engineering Wiring Diagrams.
* Compliance Deliverables: Author and approve technical/substantiation notes, installation instructions, and Service Bulletins (SBs).
* Project Team Representation: Represent the electrical discipline during multi-functional team meetings and directly report status to the Project Manager.
* On-Site Technical Assistance: Provide real-world engineering support to the working party technicians during the actual aircraft modification phase.

* Ensure all cabin electrical designs strictly align with applicable aviation regulations and Airbus engineering requirements.
* Perform all technical tasks utilizing approved company processes, engineering tools, and strict ethics/compliance standards.
* Actively manage your tasks to ensure all deliverables stay within the agreed project schedule and budget **.**

* Identify opportunities to streamline, simplify, or automate current engineering procedures, design workflows, and software tools.
* Promote lean ways of working and champion constructive changes within the engineering team.
* Capture and share lessons learned from completed retrofit projects to improve global execution.

* Partner with the Program team during the initial offer phase to provide technical estimations and quotations for prospective customer modifications.
Maintain agility by occasionally supporting simple cabin mechanical design tasks, configuration management, or technical publication updates as needed.  

  
  

**Your boarding pass:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Electrical, Aeronautical, or Civil Engineering).

* Minimum of 3 years of experience in the aviation industry, with a direct focus on aircraft cabin electrical systems design, development, and certification pathways.

* Authorized to Work in the US

* ATA Chapter Expertise: Strong engineering experience with embedded aircraft electrical systems across key ATA chapters, including:

* ATA 23 (Communications)
* ATA 24 (Electrical Power)
* ATA 25 (Cabin Equipment/Galley/In-Flight Entertainment)
* ATA 26 (Fire Protection)
* ATA 33 (Lights)
* ATA 44 (Cabin Systems)
* Substantiation & Testing: Proven hands-on experience developing Safety Analyses, Electrical Load Analyses (ELA), Electromagnetic Interference (EMI) mitigations, and Ground Test Instructions.

* Regulations & Pubs: Working knowledge of equipment qualification standards DO-160 and DO-178. Mastery of standard Aircraft Publications including AMMs, AWMs, and IPCs.

* General technical knowledge of Airbus aircraft systems and architectures.

* Familiarity with EASA Part 21 (DOA / POA) and Part 145 regulatory frameworks.

* Prior experience managing technical projects or navigating complex aircraft configuration management.

* A highly collaborative team player with a synthetic mindset (ability to condense complex electrical issues into clean, executable concepts).

* Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to confidently present technical data to executive leadership.

* High motivation and flexibility to shift gears smoothly in a demanding, fast-paced ret

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

**Senior Systems Engineer**

**Why This is an Exciting Role:**

As a Senior Systems Engineer at Boeing Intelligence & Analytics (BI&A), you will play a key role in developing and integrating mission-critical systems in a highly secure and technically dynamic environment on the System Integration Test and Readiness (SITR) contract for the Ground-based Missile Defense (GMD) program with the Missile Defense Agency (MDA). In this position, you will lead integration, test, and readiness activities across complex system environments, helping ensure critical ground systems are prepared for successful execution. You will work directly with the team’s Technical Lead, customers, and cross-functional teams to drive requirements to understanding, translate requirements into system architecture, design and define interface requirements, lead testing and validation, develop test strategies, and supply issue resolution and/or direction. This role offers the opportunity to influence high level technical direction, lead a team through high-visibility integration efforts, and support capabilities that directly contribute to national security missions.

**Experience and Qualifications:**

To be eligible for this demanding position, the ideal candidate should demonstrate the following experience and qualifications:

* Lead technical integration and test activities in a lab or operational environment.

* Partner with customer stakeholders, program leadership, and engineering teams to execute complex systems efforts.

* Ensure system integration of components meets requirements.

* Oversee implementation and verification of system under test (SUT) capabilities.

* Develop strategies, review, and release test plans, procedures, and readiness artifacts.

* Support critical fielded hardware.

* Assess engineering documentation and contribute to test readiness reviews, post-test reports, and technical briefings.

* Coordinate across systems engineering, software, hardware, network, and test disciplines to support end-to-end execution.

* Support design verification, requirements to architecture, and interface integration efforts.

* Communicate clearly and effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.

* Work independently in a fast-paced environment while leading team execution.

**Required Education and Years of Experience:**

* Education/experience typically acquired through advanced technical education from an accredited course of study in engineering, engineering technology (includes manufacturing engineering technology), computer science, engineering data science, mathematics, physics or chemistry (e.g. Bachelor) and typically 14 or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of technical education and experience or non-US equivalent qualifications. In the USA, ABET accreditation is the preferred, although not required, accreditation standard.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Requires US Citizenship as a condition of employment

* Active U.S. Secret Clearance (or higher)

* Experience on GMD program(s) with the Missile Defense Agency

* Documented experience and familiarization with GBIs (Ground-based Interceptors)

* Experience in coordinating with customers, senior engineers, and program stakeholders on complex technical work

* Experience supporting requirements decomposition, design verification, and interface management

* Experience preparing and presenting technical status, readiness, and test results in classified labs

* Experience as a Test Conductor

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience preparing and presenting technical status, readiness, and test results

* Experience in directly navigating complex client requirements and providing tailored engineering solutions

* Familiarity with IMS (Integrated Master Schedule), requirements management, and design verification processes

* Familiarity with NGI (Next Generation Interceptor) and IVTs (Integration Verification Tests) testing

* Experience leading a medium sized team in technical execution activities

* Experience on a program that provided critical support of fielded hardware

**Telework/Remote Availability: Telework**/Remote work currently not authorized

**Work Location(s):** Huntsville, AL

**Summary Pay Range:**

Please note that the information shown below is a general guideline only. Pay is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

$136,000 - $210,000

As a fully owned subsidiary of The Boeing Company, BI&A offers an optimal mix of a small company environment with exceptional opportunities supported by a large corporation.

Every day, Boeing Intelligence & Analytics supports global missions by building and delivering intelligence, analytics, and cyber solutions that enable users to advance national security. From hardware and software engineering solutions to analytics that keep this nation safe, we create value that meets users’ needs. jobs.description:
deciBel Research has an immediate opening for an Electrical Engineer in Huntsville, AL.

**Position Description:**

Become a part of something IMPACT-ful! Ground Missile Defense (GMD) is the heart of the Missile Defense System and a key element of our nation's defense against ballistic missile attacks.

The GMD Weapon System (GWS) processes data from multiple sensors to identify and characterize the inbound ballistic missile threat, plans the best defensive solution, and launches the intercepting missiles to negate the threat.

**Education Requirements:**

Bachelor's Degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics) discipline from an accredited university

**Experience Requirements:**

* Bachelor's Degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics) discipline from an accredited university and 2 years of related experience, or a Master's Degree and 0 years of related experience, or 0 years of related experience with a PhD.
* Ability and willingness to travel up to 10% of the time.
* Applicants must have a current active in-scope U.S. Government DoD issued Secret security clearance at the time of application which is required to start.
* Must be able to support an in-office / closed-area work environment full-time.
* Ability to communicate data in a clear and concise manner.
* 2 years of recent professional experience using a CAD Package such as Visio, AutoCAD, SolidWorks, CREO, Siemens Capital Suites (Logic/Harness), or NX to develop technical drawings
* Experience in two or more of the following areas: electrical/power system design, network communication system design, cable harness fabrication design, and perform electrical load analysis.
* Understanding and application of industry and company electrical engineering technical standards and procedures; demonstrated electrical component design experience and impact assessment / trade studies development.
* Prior experience with engineering PLM systems such as Teamcenter and MRP system such as SAP.
* Proficiency with Microsoft applications such as Excel, Word, Access, Outlook, Team, and PowerPoint

**Special Skills Desired:**

* Bachelors or Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering
* Familiarity with Missile Defense Agency (MDA) Core Standards: MDA-QS-001-MAP, MDA-QS-003-PMAP, MDA Instruction 5000.20-INS (ETR Process)
* Familiarity with MIL-STD-1901A, MIL-STD-882, MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, IEEE 802.3u, IEEE 802.3ab, TEMPEST 01-13, NEC
* Familiarity with the GMD domain and GMD Launch Support Systems hardware
* Experience modeling with Cameo Enterprise Architecture, Visio or other architecture modeling tools
* Experience in documenting Interface Control Documents, Interface Requirement Specifications, and Interface Description Documents

**Applicant selected must have an active Secret security clearance**. Must be a U.S. Citizen.

jobs.title: Model Based Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  
Join BAE Systems' Infrastructure Management Center (IMC) and help shape National Security. We are seeking a motivated Systems Engineer to join our dynamic, cross-functional team. In this role, you will support the planning, design, and integration of complex technical challenges that support critical national security missions, including nuclear missions, production facilities, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, and ammunition plant infrastructure.
  
This is an ideal role for an early-career engineer looking to grow within a matrix-type organization. You will have the opportunity to collaborate across multiple departments, leveraging digital engineering tools and Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) practices to deliver cutting-edge solutions for the warfighter.
  
  
The Role
  
  
As a Model-Based Systems Engineer, you will lead the transition from document-centric to model-centric engineering, driving the integration and analysis of complex hardware and software systems. Your primary responsibilities will include:
  
  
The Role
  
As a Model-Based Systems Engineer, you will lead the transition from document-centric to model-centric engineering, driving the integration and analysis of complex hardware and software systems. Your primary responsibilities will include:

* Model-Based Architecture: Develop and maintain system architectures using SysML to improve requirement traceability and change control for both new and legacy programs.
* Digital Thread Integration: Utilize Cameo Systems Modeler and DOORS to create a "single source of truth," ensuring seamless alignment between stakeholder needs, system design, and verification artifacts.
* Interface & Boundary Definition: Lead the definition of system-level interfaces and boundary conditions to facilitate hardware and software integration across multi-disciplinary teams.
* Requirements Engineering: Manage the full requirements lifecycle, translating mission profiles and operational requirements into precise system specifications and model elements.
* Technical Analysis & Trade Studies: Evaluate system-level risks and perform trade studies within the model to support informed technical, cost, and schedule decision-making.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the primary technical liaison between government stakeholders and prime contractor teams, ensuring that model outputs meet customer expectations.
* Digital Process Improvement: Implement and champion Agile methodologies and digital engineering best practices to optimize the management of critical infrastructure programs.
* Mentor and train team members who are new to MBSE and Cameo. Provide them with guidance and best practices.
* Review models for best practices and provide clear, concise feedback on how to make improvements.
  

  
  
  
  
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related STEM field (e.g., Mathematics, Physics, Chemical Engineering).
* 6 years of technical experience (4 years with MS) with a proven track record in systems engineering and integration.
* MBSE Proficiency: Direct experience applying Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) principles and utilizing tools such as Cameo Systems Modeler, MagicDraw, or Sparx Enterprise Architect.
* Requirements Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in requirements management tools (e.g., IBM DOORS).
* Analytical Aptitude: Strong experience in system design, integration, and the analysis of complex military or commercial hardware/software systems.
* Communication: Ability to communicate complex technical architectural concepts clearly to team members, stakeholders, and customers.
* Experience mentoring and training others on how to implement and use MBSE.
  

  
  
**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Advanced Modeling: Proficiency in SysML and experience developing automated scripts (e.g., Python) to enhance modeling efficiency.
* Clearance: Ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret clearance.
* Specialized Knowledge: Familiarity with Geographic Information Systems (GIS) or other digital twin technologies.
* Certifications: Foundational certifications in Systems Engineering (INCOSE) or Project Management (PMP).
* Methodology: Deep understanding of Agile frameworks and their application in highly regulated defense environments.
* Active Security Clearance
  

  
  
**Pay Information**
  
Full-Time Salary Range: $107359 - $182510
  
  
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
  
  
Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager - Products
jobs.description:
**Description**

Sanmina Corporation (Nasdaq: SANM) is a global powerhouse in integrated manufacturing solutions serving the fastest growing segments of the global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) market. We are a global engine providing the end-to-end manufacturing backbone for the world's most essential and innovative brands. Whether it's autonomous vehicles, life-saving medical tech, next-gen aerospace, or AI/cloud infrastructure - our integrated solutions don’t just meet standards—they redefine them.

At SCI Technology, a Sanmina Company, we serve those who serve by delivering innovative, trusted and comprehensive products and services that meet and exceed the unique needs of the Defense and Aerospace sector. From avionics to tactical and airborne communications, counter-UAS, integrated manufacturing and cradle-to-grave product life cycle support, we deliver high-reliability solutions that keep service members connected and protected in the field.

Our heritage dates to 1961, as an early supplier to the space program in Huntsville, Alabama. Today, SCI offers a complete range of Defense & Aerospace solutions through our three business segments – Products, Systems Build, and Life Cycle Services. It’s SCI summed up - ALL WE DO to serve those who serve.

At this time, SCI is recruiting highly qualified candidates whose background and career goals meet our needs for a **Software Engineering Manager** in Huntsville, AL. In this role, you will lead all software development activities across our Products Group—including ruggedized intercommunication systems, avionics LRUs, and mission-critical embedded electronics—modernizing and accelerating software development by introducing agile, data-driven, and AI-assisted workflows while maintaining strict compliance with DO-178C and AS9100 standards.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead all software engineering teams supporting SCI’s product lines, providing strategic direction, daily operational oversight, and scalable organizational structure.
* Establish a modern software development framework emphasizing agility, accountability, and speed to delivery, while integrating CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevSecOps principles.
* Implement AI-assisted tools to improve coding efficiency, requirements documentation, verification accuracy, and release processes.
* Introduce metrics dashboards and accountability frameworks to track velocity, code quality, defect rates, and milestone adherence.
* Ensure all software complies with DO-178C and cybersecurity requirements, maintaining rigorous configuration and change control.
* Collaborate closely with Systems, Hardware, and Test Engineering to enable rapid integration and test cycles, and partner with the PMO to deliver accurate cost-to-complete forecasts.
* Serve as the technical authority for software design standards, tool selection, and reuse strategies across all SCI product lines.

**What You'll Bring**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 10+ years of software development experience, with 5+ years in team or technical management leading embedded or safety-critical software organizations.
* Proficiency in modern toolchains (GitLab, Jenkins, Jira, SonarQube, Docker, etc.) and AI-assisted development workflows.
* Strong command of agile methodologies, requirements traceability, quality metrics, and driving measurable improvements in delivery speed and quality.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills to motivate teams and hold them accountable.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Security Clearance.

**How to Stand Out**

* Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or Technical Management.
* Experience implementing AI-driven testing, documentation, or defect prediction within regulated environments, alongside familiarity with DO-178C, DO-330 tool qualification, and automated verification frameworks.
* Prior leadership experience in a multi-product defense electronics company.
* Active PMP or Scrum Master certification.

**Why Join Us?**

At Sanmina, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. Your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Sanmina is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment. jobs.description:
Job Description

**Hardware Engineer – New Product Development**

**Location: Chandler, AZ (Onsite)**

**Employment Type: Full-Time / Contract-to-Hire**

**About the Role**

We are seeking a hands-on Hardware Engineer to design and develop next-generation electronic products for defense and rugged commercial applications. The ideal candidate does their own schematic capture and PCB layout end-to-end; this is not an architecture-only or oversight role. The right person has taken boards from concept through production, debugged them when they broke, and learned from it.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own hardware design end-to-end: schematic capture, PCB layout, prototyping, board bring-up, and debug through production release.
* Design circuit boards for rugged, industrial, commercial, or defense-adjacent applications (not high-volume consumer electronics).
* Work with microprocessor-based designs, including digital interfaces (GPIO, ADC, high-speed buses) and general digital/mixed-signal circuit design.
* Design power electronics in the 1-5kW range (not low-power audio/amplifier-scale work).
* Design hardware in a way that supports the embedded/firmware team's work, even without writing firmware directly. Prior firmware exposure is a plus.
* Collaborate with mechanical and systems engineers to integrate hardware into full electro-mechanical products.
* Participate in client-facing design reviews and program updates.
* Use AI-assisted tools (e.g., for design review) as part of the standard workflow; comfort with this is expected, not optional.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Enough experience to have been through a full product cycle, from design through production through field issues, but not so specialized that the candidate has only worked on isolated pieces of larger programs.
* Ground-up PCB design experience is required. Candidates who have only worked at large companies with dedicated layout technicians (i.e., don't do their own layout) are not a fit.
* Proficiency with Altium Designer preferred. Candidates with only KiCad/Eagle experience will be viewed as more hobbyist-level; Altium experience is a plus but not a strict filter if the rest of the background is strong.
* Experience with microprocessor-based digital design and high-speed routing/bus design.
* Power electronics experience (battery or power supply design in the 1-5kW range) is valued.
* Strong hands-on debugging ability. Candidates should be able to bring past board work to an interview and walk through what went wrong and how they fixed it.
* No fear of or resistance to AI tools in the engineering workflow. This has become a real culture filter for the team.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in rugged product design for automotive, medical, industrial, or defense/aerospace applications. Defense/aerospace background is a plus but not required.
* Familiarity with relevant MIL-STDs (461 EMI, 810 environmental) or equivalent rugged design standards from automotive/medical work.
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related discipline preferred, not a hard requirement if experience supports the above.

**Soft Skills / Culture Fit (Critical)**

* High emotional intelligence and comfort working directly with clients.
* Strong accountability and humility around design mistakes; the team wants to see how a candidate responds when something breaks, not blame-shifting or overconfidence.
* Comfortable in a culture that includes firearms and alcohol on-site.
* Well-presented and professional in appearance.

**Certifications / Clearance**

* Must be a U.S. Citizen (born or naturalized). Green card holders and other work-authorized non-citizens are not eligible. No sponsorship available.
* No active clearance required. Candidate must be eligible to become ITAR-compliant.

Key changes from the old JD:

* Removed "5+ years" as a hard requirement, replaced with the "seen a full product cycle" framing since that mattered more to Andy than a specific number.
* Cut OrCAD/Mentor Graphics mentions and centered on Altium as the real preference, with the KiCad/Eagle nuance Andy raised.
* Removed system-architecture framing from the intro and responsibilities. Andy was explicit: no system architects, this is a layout/bring-up/debug role.
* Removed DFM/DFT, UL/CE/FCC/ISO regulatory language, and EMI/EMC compliance detail as formal requirements since none of that came up as a priority on the call.
* Added the AI-tool comfort requirement, since Andy flagged this as an active screening factor now.
* Added the same culture-fit section as the ME role (client-facing, humility, guns/alcohol comfort, presentation) since Andy made clear this applies identically to both hires.
* Fixed citizenship language to match the ME JD: US citizens only, no green card sponsorship.

jobs.title: Senior Software Systems Engineer II
jobs.description:
**ABOUT ROCKET LAB**

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

**SPACE SYSTEMS**

Rocket Lab's Space Systems division builds complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space including solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, and radios.

The Space Systems division has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. We have built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it's a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help get to space — our Space Systems division is empowering the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

**SENIOR SOFTWARE SYSTEMS ENGINEER II**

Rocket Lab Optical Systems solves mission-critical space domain and Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance challenges for Department of Defense and Intelligence Community customers. Our vision is to revolutionize the space-based payload market with innovative and novel designs for space, terrestrial, and airborne environments. Building on more than 20 years of electro-optical and infrared systems innovation from Geost, Rocket Lab Optical Systems delivers solutions to the warfighter for responsive, scalable sensing solutions across all orbital domains.

As a Senior Software Systems Engineer II based at our Optical Systems site in Tucson, AZ, you will have the opportunity to design, develop, and test space-based electro-optical sensors. Systems engineers are responsible for the development and maintenance of technical budgets, requirements definition, test planning and execution, and overall management of the systems engineering process. They also work hands-on with flight software and drive the technical development of our Space Systems missions.

**WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:**

* Design, integrate, and develop software for space-based optical instruments, subsystems, and payloads for airborne and space platforms
* Understand and interpret overall system architecture, deriving and allocating software and firmware requirements to ensure consistency across interfaces and subsystems
* Understand the software/firmware development pipeline and SW/FW development process, from requirements through build, integration, test, and release
* Develop and maintain:
* + Technical budgets for vehicle performance
  + Software System requirements and verification techniques
  + Simulations and analysis across vehicle functions
  + Test methods and data analysis
* Provide technical oversight of system software architecture, interfaces, mission assurance, and compliance
* Assist with programs and product management
* Develop, in collaboration with team members, interface specifications, CONOPS definition, and other design documents
* Support the development and testing of space payloads to be integrated on spacecraft platforms
* Execute software verification test campaigns on the flatsat, development unit, or flight unit, including test setup, dry runs, and formal verification runs
* Verify the correct software build and configuration are under test, confirming the as-tested configuration matches the intended verification
* Support authoring, derivation, and verification of software and firmware requirements, and maintain requirements traceability throughout the development lifecycle, addressing conflicts or gaps
* Participate in technical interchange meetings (TIMs) and represent the organization in project discussions with internal stakeholders and external partners
* Mentor other engineers on systems engineering, requirements, and verification and validation (V&V) methodologies
* Ability to support travel or off-site work, as needed

**QUALIFICATIONS YOU'LL BRING AS SENIOR SOFTWARE SYSTEMS ENGINEER II:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering (software or computer engineering)
* Active Clearance
* 8+ years of engineering experience in the aerospace industry; with 2+ years directly supporting software development projects and 1+ years in project or team leadership
* A strong knowledge of how to interpret organizational, software, and hardware technical documents
* Demonstrable experience in systems software engineering, with a strong focus on developing, testing, and integrating with space or airborne instruments
* Experience with requirements management, workflow, and modeling tools such as JAMA, DOORS, JIRA, or Cameo
* Experience supporting development programs
* U.S citizenship is required, due to program requirements

**NICE TO HAVES:**

* Active TS/SCI clearance
* Master's or PhD in engineering (software or computer engineering)
* EO/IR payload integration experience
* Proficiency in system modeling and analysis tools such as Cameo, MATLAB, Simulink, or equivalent
* Experience with the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) from requirements development through systems operations and maintenance
* Knowledge of software interfaces and communications protocols
* Hands-on expertise leading troubleshooting and resolution of system-level issues
* Demonstrated experience working with minimal supervision in complex projects
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and explain complex implementation processes to other organization members

*This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.*

jobs.description:
About Us

We’re a stable, privately-owned company where people enjoy what they do — and who they do it with. Our team sticks around, with an average tenure just shy of 10 years. That kind of loyalty doesn’t happen by accident.

We are rooted in a strong culture and shared core values. We care about our team, our customers, and each other. If you’re someone who has a passion for advancing business and improving lives through technology, values trust, integrity, and a place where your contributions matter, you’ll feel right at home here.

Purpose of the Position

The official title for this role is Technical Alignment Manager (TAM). The TAM is responsible for understanding the client’s environment, what they do, how they use their technology to enable their business, and, from a technical perspective, maintaining that relationship with them. Establishing a technical relationship with the clients allows the TAM to communicate from a hands-on level. They dig deep into a client’s operations to figure out how they work and apply technology solutions that help them work better, smarter, faster, and more efficiently while also helping reduce costs. A person in this position will continually analyze a client’s technology against the applicable company Standard(s), and/or compliance requirements, uncovering technical gaps and risks.

Because they have an in-depth knowledge of their assigned client’s IT environment, the TAM can recommend enhancements to their systems that will uphold best practices regarding cybersecurity, overall system performance, user experience, and more. The TAM’s combined knowledge of the industry and client infrastructure makes it possible for them to identify and proactively address technical risks and issues before they become bigger problems. A TAM is the technical lead for proactive service, maintenance, and planning— driving down the need for, cost, and time sink inherent in reactive support.

A successful person in this position will be highly technical, a natural troubleshooter, client-focused, and have a proactive mindset. They must be a detail-oriented self-starter who takes ownership for their responsibilities, meets deadlines, and communicates effectively with teammates, clients, and vendors.

A person in this position should thrive on solving problems and providing big company technology solutions for small businesses. They understand the balance between analysis and fixing and how checklists and standards can produce predictable results. They are driven by proactively preventing problems and implementing best practices that will influence client business success.

**Skills, Knowledge, Abilities:**

* Understanding of the importance of best practices Standards and aligning client’s technology to them
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy, ensuring client’s achieve alignment to the Standard(s), and applicable compliance requirements
* Excellent documentation, math, and organization skills
* Demonstrated ability to be proactive and take the initiative to get things done
* Effective time management skills and the ability to multitask
* Strong troubleshooting skills
* Strong problem-solving skills and self-learning to analyze problems and create a solution
* Must be able to work and communicate with clients at all levels of an organization to identify and resolve problems
* Strong customer service skills
* Basic business understanding related to technology and an ability to translate IT language to business stakeholders
* Willing to focus on continued education in the form of various certifications
* Maintains a constant mindset of “How can I help you? How can we figure this out together? Where do we go from here?”
* Ability to work both independently and under a supervisor
* Ability to work as part of a team, and always willing to help our clients and staff

jobs.title: Senior Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
About Luxer One
---------------

Luxer One designs and deploys smart locker and access systems across multifamily properties, commercial enterprises, retail chains, and food delivery networks across North America. An Assa Abloy company, our products span cloud, mobile, and physical hardware — connected through firmware that runs in the field, at scale, around the clock. We manufacture control boards, IoT gateways, access hubs, and connected locker systems, and the firmware powering those devices is what makes all of it reliable.

Why This Role Matters
---------------------

When firmware works, nobody notices. When it doesn't, a deployed device goes dark, a locker doesn't open, or a fleet of devices stops reporting health to the cloud. At Luxer One, firmware is not a support function — it is the reliability foundation of everything we ship. We are actively scaling our embedded portfolio: next-generation control boards, IoT-connected gateways, BLE and WiFi-enabled locker hardware, mesh access systems, and temperature-managed storage devices. Each program is a real production deployment with real uptime expectations and real customers on the other end.

We need a Senior Firmware Engineer who can own programs end to end — from hardware bring-up and architecture through production firmware, OTA update pipelines, and field reliability — and who brings genuine seniority to the embedded systems decisions that define product quality at scale.

Who You Are
-----------

You are a firmware engineer who is equally comfortable writing embedded C at the register level and presenting a hardware architecture decision to a cross-functional team. You do not wait for specs to be perfect before you start, and you do not consider a program done when code ships — you own it through field deployment and into production operations.

You are:

* A low-level builder — you write production C/C++ on microcontrollers, understand memory models, peripheral drivers, and timing constraints, and can debug a device in the field with an oscilloscope and a logic analyzer as readily as in a simulator
* Reliable in production — you treat uptime as a personal accountability; you build telemetry in, design OTA update paths that fail safely, and watch the fleet after launch
* A cross-discipline collaborator — you work directly with electrical engineers on schematic review and hardware bring-up, and with manufacturing partners on NPI readiness and production tooling
* A technical decision-maker — you author architecture docs and hardware specifications that others build from, not just code that implements what someone else decided
* AI-fluent — you actively use AI tools in your engineering workflow: for documentation, code review, debugging analysis, status reporting, and technical communication. You move faster and produce higher-quality artifacts because of it, and you are interested in the broader frontier of AI-assisted embedded development
* Operationally minded — you understand that embedded systems in a commercial IoT product live in the real world, subject to network outages, power interruptions, hostile environments, and user error. You design for that reality, not the happy path

And you bring:

* A track record of shipping embedded firmware for IoT or connected hardware products into production at meaningful scale
* Experience with the full embedded development lifecycle: architecture, bring-up, driver development, application firmware, manufacturing tooling, OTA, and field maintenance
* Hands-on experience with BLE, WiFi, or cellular connectivity in embedded products
* Comfort owning multiple concurrent hardware programs with limited supervision

What You'll Do
--------------

* Own firmware architecture and delivery for Luxer One's embedded hardware portfolio — including locker control boards, IoT gateways, BLE/WiFi-connected access hardware, and next-generation platform programs
* Design and implement firmware from the ground up on new hardware programs: architecture decisions, peripheral bring-up, RTOS integration, application layer, and production readiness
* Build and maintain OTA update pipelines and device management integration — including MDM enrollment, provisioning workflows, and fleet telemetry
* Partner with electrical engineers and manufacturing partners (including Ansync) on hardware design review, design for manufacturability, NPI readiness, and production validation
* Write and maintain hardware specifications, architecture decision records, and technical documentation that inform roadmap decisions and manufacturing commitments
* Maintain and improve the reliability of devices in the field — monitoring telemetry, identifying failure patterns, shipping patches, and owning uptime metrics on deployed fleets
* Contribute to firmware quality standards: code review, CI pipeline health, automated test coverage, and escape defect rates from QA
* Actively use AI tools in your workflow — for documentation generation, debugging analysis, status reporting, and code review — and help the team develop best practices for AI-assisted embedded development
* Represent embedded systems in cross-functional planning — product roadmap, NPI programs, commercial partner engagements — as the authoritative technical voice on firmware capabilities and constraints

### **Requirements**

What We're Looking For
----------------------

* Five or more years of firmware or embedded software engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of production IoT or connected hardware programs
* Strong C/C++ in an embedded context — microcontrollers, peripheral drivers, RTOS (FreeRTOS or similar), memory management
* Experience with wireless connectivity in embedded products — BLE, WiFi, or cellular — including protocol handling, reliability design, and power management
* OTA update design and implementation experience — including safe rollback, version management, and fleet-scale deployment
* Experience with hardware bring-up: schematic

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Anduril Imaging team develops state-of-the-art imaging systems across both hardware and software, deployed to tackle the most significant security challenges of America and its allies. The team is heavily involved in utilizing computer vision, perception, electro-optical, infrared, and sensor data to give our war fighters and allies an advantage.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

The Space Imaging team is seeking an Electrical Engineer to join the team. The Space Imaging team is responsible for all aspects of spaceborne EO/IR system development, from the ideation stage through initial production. In this role, you will work closely with an interdisciplinary technical team to define the electrical architecture of space-qualified EO/IR sensor payloads — including power distribution, connector/harness interfaces, EMI/EMC protection, and high-speed communication interfaces — build and test prototypes, and mature designs into flight hardware products. As needed, you will also lead small teams of engineers from concept through system definition and development.

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Electrical Architecture: Define and own the electrical architecture for EO/IR sensor payload assemblies, including power distribution, connector/harness interfaces, grounding/bonding schemes, and communication interfaces.
* Power Electronics Design: Design, analyze, and test isolated power conversion, EMI filtering, inrush current limiting, and over-voltage/reverse-polarity protection circuitry for low-voltage DC payload power systems.
* Interface & Harness Design: Select connectors, define pin assignments, perform wire/cable and component derating analyses, and establish shielding, bonding, and isolation schemes to meet EMI/EMC requirements.
* Communication Interfaces: Design and support high-speed Ethernet (10GbE) and discrete I/O (RS-422, I2C, SPI) interfaces between sensor electronics and host avionics.
* EMC/ESD: Support EMI/EMC qualification testing (MIL-STD-461/464), and ESD protection design.
* Radiation Compliance: Radiation-tolerant (TID/SEU) component selection for space and tactical environments.
* Parts Stress & Reliability Analysis: Perform EEE parts stress/derating analyses and support hybrid microelectronics selection to ensure reliable operation across mission life.
* Hardware/Software Integration: Collaborate with firmware, mechanical, optical, and systems engineers to integrate electrical designs into sensor payload assemblies, including bring-up and verification testing.
* Testing and Validation: Develop and execute test procedures using lab equipment (oscilloscopes, power supplies, network analyzers, EMI test gear) to validate designs against functional and performance requirements.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Education: A Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field is typically required.
* Experience: 8+ years of experience designing power, interface, or mixed-signal electronics for space, airborne, or other harsh-environment defense systems.
* Power Electronics & Circuit Design: Experience designing isolated DC/DC power conversion, EMI filters, and transient/over-voltage protection circuits for low-voltage DC systems.
* EMI/EMC Standards: Familiarity with MIL-STD-461 and MIL-STD-464 (or equivalent) EMI/EMC design and test methods.
* Interface/Harness Design: Experience with connector selection, pin/harness definition, and parts/wire derating analysis (e.g., per MIL-HDBK-1547A or equivalent).
* Debugging Skills: Strong hardware debugging skills using standard lab equipment (oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic/protocol analyzers).
* Analysis Tools: Proficiency with schematic capture/circuit simulation tools and worst-case stress/derating analysis.
* US Person status is required as this position needs to access export controlled data
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience designing radiation-tolerant electronics and performing TID/SEU analysis for space systems
* Experience with high-speed digital/communication interfaces (10GbE, SERDES) and signal integrity analysis
* Familiarity with machine-vision/sensor communication protocols (e.g., GigE Vision)

**Job Details**
===============

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

**Responsibilities:**

The **JPL Communications and Instruments Division** perform scientific investigations, advanced technology research, engineering developments and system implementations encompassing space telecommunications, tracking and active remote sensing using electromagnetic waves.

The **Flight Communications and Tracking Section** provides cost-effective space communications systems, software defined radios, high power RF amplifiers, and power supplies that support primary telecom subsystems and major radar and radiometer science payloads. The section also provides Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) flight equipment, radiometric science instruments, high stability frequency standards and clocks and seismometers for NASA/JPL missions. In addition to flight hardware expertise, the section specializes in collection of and processing of worldwide, fixed site, GNSS data that is processed into clock, atmospheric, and ionospheric GNSS correction metrics. The section also develops high stability frequency references and clocks for flight and ground applications.

The Flight Communications & Tracking Section at JPL is looking for a **Software Engineer III** to join their **Software Defined Radios Group** to support flight software development and implementation for the **Polar Rover for Observation, Mapping, and In-Situ Exploration** (PROMISE) telecom subsystem. The Group leads the development of software / firmware defined digital flight electronics for telecom, radio metrics, and radar support applications. Work includes development and implementation of flight signal processing algorithms, complex spacecraft interfaces, and various data transfer and communications protocols that enable and support telecom, radar science, instruments, and spacecraft safety and health. Group members work on all phases of product development from early concept, low technology readiness specification and prototyping to engineering and flight model development and implementation, functional and environmental testing, and flight operations support.

PROMISE is a NASA lunar rover mission intended to explore the lunar south pole as part of the Moon Base program. As the PROMISE telecom Software Engineer, you will be responsible for the development, implementation, test, and delivery of the Boot Code Software and the Application Software designs that are part of the Universal Space Transponder (UST) radio family. You will be a member of the multidisciplinary implementation team consisting of approximately 7 full-time equivalent employees, industry partners, and subcontractors. * Support or lead flight software reviews and Software Readiness Certification Records (SRCRs)
* Generate software End Item Data Package (EIDP) and prepare software flight releases

**About Varda**

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. **Varda's W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.**

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. **What you'll do**  
  
  

The System Software team owns the foundational OS layer — AlmaLinux-based embedded servers called Mobility Access Servers (MAS) — that powers inflight WiFi and streaming content on the world's leading airlines. You'll work on the software stack from bootloader to application services: storage health, container orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, security hardening, and field incident investigation. When something goes wrong on a production aircraft, your team is the one that figures out why and ships the fix.

This is a site-based role; employees work 3+ days (60%+) per week from a Viasat office or work location within a standard five-day workweek.

  
  
**The day-to-day**  
  
  

- Software engineering as part of an agile development team

- Actively design and drive software architecture involving a Linux-based operating system with custom support applications involving REST, HW interfaces, ARINC controllers, cellular device controllers, and other low-level driver support

- Participate in the design, development, and testing of software products we support

- Maintain and improve our current setup for continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) systems, with a focus on applying GitHub Actions, Artifactory, Vault, and GitHub

- Improve and implement testing, both virtual and on bare metal hardware, to improve software quality by catching issues before they reach production

- Debug and investigate production system failures using log analysis tools (syslog-ng, fluent-bit, journalctl) and field data from live aircraft deployments

- Manage and maintain ZFS storage pools, disk health monitoring, and storage subsystem reliability

- Develop, deploy, and maintain containerized services using Docker and k3s (lightweight Kubernetes) on embedded hardware

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering

- Hands-on experience with Object Oriented methodology and development

- Proficiency with Linux system administration: systemd service lifecycle, boot process debugging, and log-based forensics (journalctl, syslog)

- Experience with container technologies (Docker) and/or container orchestration (Kubernetes/k3s)

- Experience investigating and debugging field incidents and production system failures, including reading system logs, correlating events across services, and driving to root cause

- Experience with developing and delivering software using CI/CD and DevOps practices

- Familiarity with common development and infrastructure tools including Git, GitHub, Docker, HashiCorp Vault, and artifact management platforms (e.g. Artifactory)

- Ability to champion modern software practices and uphold software quality standards in all phases of development

- Strong analytical skills and the ability to evaluate software architecture & design, including existing codebases

- Performing tests following a requirement-based testing approach

- Familiarity with AI coding tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development

  
  
**What will help you on the job**

- Deep understanding of the bootloader and application bring-up process

- Experience orchestrating and optimizing resources (CPU, memory, disk) using tools such as cgroups and MGLRU

jobs.title: Flight Telecom Systems Engineer II
jobs.description:
**Job Details**
===============

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

**Responsibilities:**

The **JPL Communications and Instruments Division** performs scientific investigations, advanced technology research, engineering developments and system implementations encompassing space telecommunications, tracking and active remote sensing using electromagnetic waves.

The **Flight Communications and Tracking Section** provides cost-effective space communications systems, software defined radios, high power RF amplifiers, and power supplies that support primary telecom subsystems and major radar and radiometer science payloads. The section also provides Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) flight equipment, radiometric science instruments, high stability frequency standards and clocks and seismometers for NASA/JPL missions. In addition to flight hardware expertise, the section specializes in collection of and processing of worldwide, fixed site, GNSS data that is processed into clock, atmospheric, and ionospheric GNSS correction metrics. The section also develops high stability frequency references and clocks for flight and ground applications.

The Flight Communications & Tracking Section at JPL is looking for a highly motivated and experienced **Flight Telecom Systems Engineer II** to join their Communication System Engineering and Operations Group. As a member of this Group, you will have an opportunity to be involved in all phases of product development from early concept and mission formulation, low technology readiness specification and prototyping to engineering and flight model development and implementation, functional and environmental testing, and flight operations support. In this role, you will perform complex and varied engineering tasks within the telecom discipline, partnering with senior engineers across all phases of the product lifecycle.

**Tasks include but are not limited to:**

  

* Provide telecom system engineering support on various flight telecom subsystems for deep-space interplanetary missions, Earth-orbiting missions, and lunar/Mars relay networks.
* Demonstrate the collaborative, team-oriented approach expected of a future technical leader by proactively supporting teammates, sharing knowledge, and contributing to a positive, safety-conscious team culture.
* Take ownership of assigned tasks and deliverables, communicating progress, risks, and recommendations clearly to senior engineers and task leads.
* Build strong working relationships across the telecom team and with other subsystem engineers, laying the groundwork for future technical leadership roles.
* Participate actively in technical reviews and team discussions, offering sound engineering judgment and contributing to decisions that build trust with senior staff.
* Generate telecom component and subsystem-level requirements, responding to project and flight system needs with appropriate requirements flow down
* Develop and prepare interface agreements between the telecom subsystem and other spacecraft subsystems.
* Conduct system-level link analyses, using statistically-derived link parameters
* Partner with other engineers to evaluate current telecom components, algorithms, subsystems, and end-to-end system performance.
* Conduct software simulations and hardware tests, summarizing results to verify telecom system functionality.
* Contribute new ideas and concepts toward the improvement of existing telecom products and technologies.
* Present analyses and technical results at peer-level design and technical reviews.
* Contribute technical content, data, and graphics to proposal and Concept Study Report (CSR) development efforts.
* Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on concept development teams, applying telecom-specific expertise to devise, validate, and benchmark new approaches to technical challenges.
* Support the tracking and documentation of mass, power, and data volume specifications and allocations for assigned telecom components, under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Perform and/or provide independent review of reliability analyses (worst-case, parts stress, radiation, thermal, structural, etc.) and interface failure mode analysis.
* Draft or update telecom functional description documents, comm behavior manager documents, and other design control documents related to the telecom subsystem such as Interface Control Documents, Requirements Documents, Test Report Documents, Design Description Documents, etc.
* Create detailed test plans, procedures, and reports aligned with V&V objectives
* Support development of verification and validation (V&V) plans under the guidance of senior engineers, helping ensure compliance with system requirements
* Support key spacecraft-level Assembly, Test, and Launch Operations (ATLO) tests such as subsystem functional test, ground-station compatibility testing (with the Deep Space Network, Near Space Network, or other commercial providers), and environmental testing.
* Collaborate with ground station providers including the Deep Space Network (DSN), Near Space Network (NSN), European Space Tracking Network (ESTRACK), and commercial providers (eg KSAT).
* Support mission and concept proposal teams by providing subject matter expertise on telecom subsys

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Early Career) – C++ & Systems
jobs.description:
**About SirenOpt**

SirenOpt helps manufacturers make better, safer, and more reliable micro- and nano-materials. These materials are the building blocks of critical sectors of the global economy such as batteries, computer chips, aircraft components, and power systems. But, surging material demand and growing complexity are pushing production to unprecedented scales and speeds, leaving manufacturers effectively flying blind. Small, undetected variations during production lead to wastage, lower performance, higher costs, and safety risks.

SirenOpt is changing this by developing a manufacturing intelligence platform that non-destructively probes materials during production, revealing critical internal information without damaging them. Using a novel combination of cold atmospheric plasma, physics-informed machine learning, and predictive analytics, SirenOpt generates unique, real-time material fingerprints that capture material signals not accessible through conventional measurement techniques. These insights give manufacturers unprecedented visibility into how materials behave as they are made.

We turn hidden data into actionable intelligence to help manufacturers reduce variability and thus increase yield and performance. The technology can be deployed as a standalone tool or integrated directly into factory production lines. SirenOpt is currently deploying early versions of its platform with some of the largest industrial manufacturers in the world across North America, Europe, and Asia.

**About the job**

**Job Title:** Software Engineer (Early Career) – C++ & Systems

**Location:** On-Site (San Leandro, CA)

**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Role Overview**

SirenOpt is seeking a **Software Engineer** to help build and maintain the real-time data pipeline behind our sensing platform: acquiring data from multiple sensors, processing and storing it on Linux-based systems, and delivering it to the applications our customers rely on.

You will work primarily in modern C++ and Python, with mentorship from senior engineers, and you will be hands-on with real hardware in our lab to test and validate what you build. This is a role for someone who wants to grow into a well-rounded systems engineer by shipping production software end to end, from a first design discussion to a feature running at a customer site.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop and maintain software components in modern C++ (C++17/20) for Linux-based systems, with guidance from senior engineers
* Implement features, fix bugs, and write unit and integration tests across the data pipeline, from sensor acquisition through processing and storage to the services that deliver results to applications
* Write and maintain Python scripts for automation, testing, and data analysis
* Read, and where needed modify, existing code written in other languages across our codebase
* Use AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development, and verify their output through testing, profiling, and code review
* Run the system on real hardware in the lab to test and validate your changes, including setting up sensors and collecting data
* Participate in code reviews, both receiving and giving feedback, and follow team conventions for code quality
* Help diagnose and debug issues across software and hardware boundaries, working with firmware and hardware engineers
* Measure and improve performance of existing code under the direction of senior engineers
* Document your work so that others on the team can build on it

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field (recent graduates welcome)
* 0–2 years of professional software development experience; internships, co-ops, research, and substantial personal or open-source projects count
* Solid foundation in C++, including memory management, references and pointers, the standard library, and basic object-oriented and generic programming
* Strong ability to read, understand, and write Python, including working within existing Python codebases used for automation, testing, and data analysis
* Ability to pick up new programming languages quickly; our codebase spans several languages and you will need to read, and occasionally modify, code outside of C++ and Python
* Understanding of core computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and concurrency basics
* Comfortable with the everyday toolchain: Linux command line, build tools (CMake or similar), a debugger, and Git-based workflows (branches, pull requests, code review)
* Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) as part of a real development workflow, and the judgment to review and test what they produce
* Comfortable working hands-on with lab and test equipment: setting up sensors, running the system on real hardware, and collecting data for testing and validation (we will train you on our specific equipment)
* Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work well with teammates across disciplines

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with Qt, gRPC, or Protocol Buffers
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing
* Experience with profiling and debugging tools such as perf, Valgrind, GDB, or sanitizers
* Familiarity with hardware communication interfaces such as Ethernet, USB, or Serial
* Contributions to open-source projects

The RTP team is responsible for the end-to-end hardware lifecycle of all Meta servers, including prototyping, pre-production hands-on system validation, hardware debugging, and stress testing. As a Production Systems Engineer, you will work closely with various teams, including HW/SW co-design teams, hardware designers, networking teams, system manufacturers, component vendors, capacity engineering, production engineering, production services, and data center operations teams to enable new systems that will be deployed in our production data centers.

* Support end-to-end system validation, and deployment for cutting-edge Compute and Storage hardware platforms, including CPUs, flash, and data center processing units (DPUs) in data center environments
* Proactively create experiments and tooling to diagnose and root cause hardware, firmware, and software failures across compute, storage, and networking systems using telemetry, logs, and hands-on debugging
* Design and implement robust system-level test plans, including functional, stress, and performance tests
* Drive component vendors and system manufacturers to resolve hardware and firmware issues identified during production operations
* Interface with external vendors and internal teams to understand the system architecture and develop Hardware Fault Management for various server products

* Leverage understanding of RAS (reliability, availability, serviceability) to improve error reporting and error handling mechanisms for better operation quality and cost/efficiency
* Analyze production failure data to identify systemic trends and drive corrective actions with internal teams and external vendors

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer - Test Development
jobs.description:
Zoox is building a purpose-built, fully autonomous robotaxi, and every electronic control unit (ECU) on it has to be proven before it reaches a vehicle. The Autonomy Hardware Validation team in Robot Platform Verification & Validation runs the design validation (DV) and production validation (PV) testing that shows our ECUs meet their requirements across temperature, power, vibration, EMC and lifetime stress.

As a Hardware Engineer on our Test Development team, you will be the hands-on engineer who gets testing done in our Foster City labs. You will build test setups and automation, run tests, and help find the root cause of failures. You will move between projects as needs shift, including next-generation vehicle platforms, production validation for our current robotaxi, and cold-weather qualification. You will use AI tools and automation to build and run tests faster.

### **In this role, you will:**

Build, debug and maintain test setups for vehicle ECUs, including fixtures, test carts, harnesses, fault injection racks, power supplies, electronic loads, data acquisition and thermal chambers.

Run electrical, environmental and reliability tests in our Foster City labs and at local test labs, and document the results clearly.  
Write test automation and tools in Python, and use AI tools to review specifications and test procedures, synthesize results and speed up test development.

Support root cause analysis of test failures with validation, design, firmware and supplier quality engineers, and track issues to closure in Jira.

Add capacity where it’s needed most, working with validation leads to turn their validation plans into working test setups and procedures.

### **Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of experience in hardware test, hardware validation or electrical engineering, and a BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related field.
* Hands-on experience with lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, DMMs and data acquisition systems.
* Experience building or modifying test setups such as harnesses, fixtures or instrumentation, and reading schematics to debug board-level issues.
* Working proficiency in Python for test automation or data analysis.
* Comfortable using AI tools to review documents, synthesize information and build test tooling, and checking their output critically.
* Experience with fault injection, hardware-in-the-loop or automated test equipment for electronics.
* Experience with automotive validation standards such as ISO 16750, CISPR 25 or ISO 11452, including EMC or cold-weather testing.
* Experience working in Jira, Polarion or another ALM tool.

jobs.title: Senior Firmware Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy hacking and tinkering at the lowest levels of software? Are you capable of crafting and implementing creative secure firmware solutions in heavily resource-constrained environments? If so, you’re primed to help develop the boot software that powers the world’s best GPUs. NVIDIA is searching for an outstanding security software engineer to fill an exciting, yet fun role on our GPU Firmware team. You will be joining a team whose primary mission is solving the intricate enigma of securing and innovating the boot process for our GPUs, while working through the formidable constraints of boot-time and storage space. Every. Byte. Counts.

The GPU Firmware team builds the root of trust firmware for GPUs that provides secure boot, update, and attestation services for all our GPU products from gaming to high-performance compute in the datacenter. We want your help to build an industry leading security posture for a security critical component across all these products.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Design, develop, test, debug, and optimize GPU firmware throughout the entire GPU lifecycle
* Continuously evaluate and improve the security posture of firmware and hardware that form the root of trust for our products
* Improve team software process and core infrastructure by enhancing build systems, regression farms, and security test infrastructure
* Participate in in-depth security reviews of software, hardware, process, and infrastructure
* Facilitate security requirements and solutions by participating in industry standards such as NIST, Open Compute Project, DMTF etc., and aligning with key customers and partners
* Collaborate with NVIDIA’s and third-party vendors’ hardware and software teams to improve security across hardware, BootROMs, and software stacks
* Work within a larger virtual security team on other parts of the GPU stack, as necessary

**What we need to see:**

* BS or MS degree in EE/CS/CE (or equivalent experience)
* 5+ years’ experience in developing device BIOS, firmware, or other low-level software
* 2+ years’ experience in building secure firmware and working with hardware security components
* Strong C skills
* Secure software fundamentals including cryptography, authentication/attestation, chains of trust, and understanding of common SW security vulnerabilities
* Easy to work with, as you’ll constantly work closely with both hardware designers and other software engineers to design, develop, and debug functional (and non-functional!) aspects of GPU subsystems

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Experience with threat modeling, formal design analysis, hardware/firmware architecture, and other demonstrable security experience in a defensive security focused role.
* Background with secure development techniques such as attack-trees, static/dynamic analysis, fuzzing, and negative testing
* Experience developing for safety critical platforms
* Experience with formal verification
* Passion for your work

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 152,000 USD - 241,500 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

jobs.description:

Advanced Energy (Nasdaq: AEIS) is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of highly engineered, precision power conversion, measurement and control solutions for mission-critical applications and processes. AE’s power solutions enable customer innovation in complex applications for a wide range of industries including semiconductor equipment, industrial, manufacturing, telecommunications, data center computing and healthcare. Advanced Energy has devoted four decades to perfecting power for its global customers and is headquartered in Denver, Colorado.

  

**WHY BE A PART OF ADVANCED ENERGY?**

Some people say it’s like working in the best of two worlds. We operate like an agile, growing, small company – you can see your work make a difference to the company every day. Things move quickly and you can see and feel it. At the same time, we’re a global company founded in 1981 and have been publicly traded for more than 28 years. We have a strong cash position, deep trust and partnership with leading customers, a global best-in-class operations capability, and a proven leadership team. We have a track record and resources to make things happen both organically and inorganically. Being part of a nimble company with a solid foundation attracts team members that are capable, driven and like a challenge. Our employees collaborate and know how to have fun inventing, working, building and winning together. At our core, we are Advanced Energy – powering the future, together.

  

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

This is a key position which will require you to lead the embedded firmware architecture for the next generation platform using C++ object-oriented programing and real time embedded systems. The individual in this role needs to have strong embedded design experience to design and modify to evaluate embedded software, programmable logic, electronic apparatus, components, or circuitry for use in electronic equipment and devices.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Participates in all phases of the embedded program development life cycle, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, integration, and test of all products
