* Designs product architectures to meet specific parameters. Including critical timing, complex algorithms, configuration strategies, and module interfaces
  

**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

* Location: Redwood City, CA
* Environment: Standard office environment
  

**QUALIFICATIONS****:**

**Required:**

* C++ programming experience with embedded systems
* Strong understanding of real-time operating systems (RTOS), including task scheduling, inter-thread communication, synchronization primitives, and managing concurrency in multi-threaded environments
* Hands-on laboratory experience is critical and required. Specifically experience with Logic Analyzers and Oscilloscopes
* Familiarity with I2C, SPI, Ethernet, USB
* Familiarity with development of self-checking tests scripts and automation
* Must be able to pass an online technical assessment Familiarity with timing analysis, timing closure, and design pipelining.
* Ability to read schematics and troubleshoot digital designs down to component level
* Strong understanding of synchronous design practices and data flow management (FIFOs, memories, pipelining)
* Embedded programming in C++ with RTOS and multiple threads
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  

**Preferred:**

* Experience in signal and power integrity analysis of embedded digital designs
* Experience in developing specifications, and resource requirements for digital/FPGA designs
* Experience with EtherCAT, Profibus and DeviceNET
* Experience interfacing with Xilinx FPGAs and SoCs desired
* Familiarity with agile, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CICD)
* Experience with embedded microprocessors within FPGAs desired
* Experience with Xilinx tools and FPGA HDL coding development

**EXPERIENCE:**

* 1-5 years of C++ development experience.
* Experience collaborating with hardware and software teams.
* Required hands-on laboratory and hardware debugging experience.
  

**EDUCATION:**

* B.S. or M.S. in Electrical or Computer Engineering or related field.
  

**COMPENSATION:**

Actual compensation is influenced by an array of factors including, but not limited to, skill set, level of experience, and specific office location. The range of starting pay for this role is $90,000 to $150,000 per year.*

**BENEFITS:**

As part of our total rewards philosophy, we believe in offering and maintaining competitive compensation and benefits programs for our employees to attract and retain a talented, highly engaged workforce. Our compensation programs are focused on equitable, fair pay practices including market-based base pay, an annual pay-for-performance incentive plan, and discounted Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

We are a leader in the development of innovative DNA sequencing instruments that transform the landscape of genomics. Our flagship products, such as the NovaSeq X and 6K series, drive scientific discoveries across healthcare and biotechnology. Join us and bring your expertise to products that make a difference globally.

  

As a Staff Electrical Engineer in our Lifecycle Management team, you will be a technical leader responsible for overseeing the entire electrical-system lifecycle of our high-performance sequencing products — from New Product Introduction (NPI) through sustaining phases until end-of-life. **Qualifications:**

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Software Engineer - Deep Learning Solutions
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is a global leader in physical AI, powering self-driving cars, humanoid robots, intelligent environments, and medical devices. Our software platforms are central to this mission. We help innovators build products that save lives, enhance working conditions, and improve living standards globally!

We are hiring a Senior Systems Software Engineer to join our team as a technical expert focused on optimizing deep learning inference for autonomous vehicles and robotics on edge devices. This role requires a hands-on specialist who can examine model architectures at the operator level. They will locate performance issues through kernel trace analysis and evaluate modern architectures (transformers, vision-language models, diffusion/flow matching, state space models) on GPU and SOC. This work directly enhances autonomous vehicles’ and robots’ ability to perceive and respond in real time, yielding immediate benefits. The group works on some of the hardest optimization challenges in the industry, positioned at the convergence of model frameworks, compiler technology, and embedded hardware. We maintain strong collaboration with automotive OEMs, robotics colleagues, and internal hardware teams to extend edge device capabilities.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Address customer and partner optimization challenges: Engage directly with prominent automotive OEMs and robotics associates to analyze, debug, and improve their deep learning models on NVIDIA platforms. We emphasize delivering solutions rather than just recommendations.
* Own performance benchmarking: Drive efforts to achieve leading results on MLPerf Edge and industry benchmarks, as well as closed-source engagements with key partners. Define methodology, ensure reproducibility, and turn results into actionable optimization priorities.
* Evaluate emerging model architectures: Investigate new DL architectures, including vision encoders, multi-modal VLMs, hybrid SSM-Transformer backbones, diffusion/flow matching decoders, and multi-camera tokenizers, regarding compilation feasibility, memory footprint, and latency on target SOCs.
* Collaborate across teams: Work alongside our compiler, runtime, and hardware groups to link model-level insight with platform capabilities.
* Contribute to build reviews and help develop internal roadmap priorities based on real customer workload patterns.
* Represent NVIDIA externally: Share our deep learning optimization expertise at conferences, webinars, and partner events. Help elevate the broader team by bringing back insights and establishing guidelines.
* Deliver TensorRT and compiler-stack solutions for edge: Build and deploy inference solutions on Jetson, DRIVE, and GPU + ARM platforms for AV and robotics workloads. Develop Proofs of Readiness (PORs) and collaborate closely with our compiler team on Torch-TRT, MLIR-TRT, and related frameworks to bridge performance gaps.

**What we need to see:**

* Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Over 12 years working in the industry, including at least 8 years specializing in deep learning model optimization, inference engineering, or neural network compilation. Proficiency in understanding and reviewing model architectures at the operator/kernel level, not merely handling their operation, is required.
* Over 5 years of validated expertise in embedded/edge software, with experience delivering production inference solutions within power-limited, latency-sensitive deployment environments.
* Comprehensive knowledge of contemporary DL architectures: transformers, attention variants, vision encoders (ViT), multi-modal/vision-language model frameworks, as well as experience with diffusion models and/or state space models.
* Expert knowledge of GPU architecture fundamentals, CUDA, and low-level performance optimization using heterogeneous computing. Experience with TensorRT, compiler IRs, or equivalent inference optimization toolchains.
* Solid understanding of embedded operating system internals (QNX/Linux), memory management, C/C++, and embedded/system software concepts.
* Background in parallel programming (e.g., CUDA, OpenMP) and experience reasoning about memory hierarchies, data movement, and compute utilization.
* Demonstrated capability to collaborate directly with external partners and customers in a deep technical role. You solve their workload issues, identify performance problems, and provide solutions within production limitations.

**Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:**

* Experience with ML compiler frameworks (TVM, MLIR, XLA, Triton) or contributing to inference runtime development.
* Production deployment experience with autonomous vehicle perception or planning stacks, understanding the full pipeline from sensor input through trajectory output.
* Familiarity with the Physical AI model landscape: VLM + action expert architectures, end-to-end driving models, or robot foundation models.
* Contributions to MLPerf benchmarks and large-scale industry performance optimization efforts.
* Experience with automotive safety standards (ISO 26262, SOTIF) and their implications for inference system development.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 18, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: Senior Flight Software Engineer (TS/SCI Cleared)
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet.

**About the Role**
==================

As a member of the Flight Software team, you will design, develop, and own the software that brings our spacecraft to life. You will tackle the hardest problems in autonomous systems and build robust software that enables reliable spacecraft operation 24/7, across every phase of a mission. You will work closely with our mission operations, GNC, and hardware teams to architect new systems, prototype ideas, and turn them into mission-critical software that ultimately flies.

Experience in the space industry is not necessary to thrive at Apex. Instead, we are looking for motivated engineers who enjoy solving complex problems, balance technical rigor with practicality, and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

The Flight Software team is composed of three interconnected teams: high-level application software, operating system software, and embedded software. There is significant collaboration and crossover across these teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design, develop, and own mission-critical software for satellite systems throughout the full software lifecycle, from initial architecture and development through deployment and operations.
* Develop rapid, iterative software to support bench and development testing, as well as robust, rigorously reviewed and validated software delivered to manufacturing and flight systems.
* Plan and execute unit, integration, and system-level testing of satellite components, diagnosing and resolving defects to ensure software quality, reliability, and performance.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with systems, hardware, test, and operations teams to establish product requirements, define technical roadmaps, and drive successful execution.
* Support spacecraft commissioning during launch and early operations, troubleshooting software and ensuring critical flight systems remain functional and reliable throughout critical mission activities.

**Requirements**
----------------

* U.S. Citizenship (must possess the ability to access export-controlled data)
* Active Top Secret clearance with SCI access and SAP eligibility
* 8+ years of total flight software experience
* Bachelor’s degree in CS, EE, or equivalent
* Strong proficiency in programming languages such as C++, Python, or Rust

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience developing, testing, deploying, and troubleshooting mission-critical satellite software from prototyping through flight operations.
* Experience with real-time software on distributed hardware platforms across multiple satellite products.
* Knowledge of embedded and real-time operating systems (e.g., Embedded Linux, Yocto, Buildroot, FreeRTOS, VxWorks).
* Experience writing and debugging low-level device drivers for hardware interfaces (e.g., SPI, I²C, UART, Ethernet, CAN, SpaceWire).
* Familiarity with satellite communication standards and protocols (e.g., CCSDS, ECSS).
* Familiarity with networking and secure communications (e.g., TCP/IP, UDP, TLS), data serialization (e.g., Protobuf, JSON, MessagePack), and encryption (e.g., AES, RSA).
* Experience translating requirements into technical solutions, defining technical roadmaps, and coordinating with cross-functional engineering teams to support project execution.
* Experience supporting spacecraft commissioning during launch and early operations.
* Experience with version control, configuration management, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines for software build, deployment, and release.

#LI-AB1

**Why Join Apex?**
==================

Apex believes in creating a work environment that you look forward to embracing every day. Our employees love working at Apex, and we want you to love it too. We're a fast-growing startup that has raised more than $500M in funding, and we invest heavily in our people from day one.

**What We Offer For Full-time Employees:**
------------------------------------------

* **Shared upside:** Receive equity in Apex, letting you benefit from the work you create
* **Best-in-class healthcare:** 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, plus $100k life insurance at no cost
* **Comprehensive PTO package:** Starting at 15 days vacation, growing to 20+ days annually, plus 10 paid holidays
* **Competitive 401(k) plan:** Generous matching - 100% match on first 3%, 50% on next 2%
* **8 weeks paid parental leave:** Plus childcare reimbursement up to $350/day for work-related travel
* **Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks:** To keep you fueled throughout the day
* **Vibrant community:** Monthly office socials, pickleball tournaments, run club, and gatherings for you and your family
* **Your dream desk setup:** All the tools you need to be your most productive self
* **World-class Playa Vista office:** With the benefit of in-person collaboration with amazing coworkers and flexibility to integrate work and life
* **Real impact opportunity:** Work alongside experts from aerospace, new space, and other cutting-edge industries to make a lasting difference

===========================

jobs.title: Staff Full-Stack Software Engineer, Manufacturing Software (ArsenalOS Deployment)
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Maritime Digital Production (MDP) is the software and digital systems function within Anduril's Heavy Metal division. We build and deploy the full technology stack that powers Anduril's shipbuilding factories: the data infrastructure that makes every machine and sensor visible in real time, the manufacturing execution system (ArsenalOS) that workers and planners use every shift, the scheduling engine that replans production in minutes instead of days, and the AI systems that eliminate manual toil from both the shop floor and business operations.  
  
MDP operates at the boundary between Operational Technology and Information Technology. Our systems live where factory-floor machines, edge compute, and OT networks meet enterprise platforms and cloud infrastructure. We incubate solutions close to the production line, validate them with real operators building real hardware, harden them for reliability and security, and then scale them across multiple sites. The environment is fast, physical, and consequential. When our systems go down, production stops. The output of our work is not a dashboard: it is a ship.  
  
This is not a support function. It is a strategic investment by Anduril in the premise that digitizing the manufacturing lifecycle end-to-end, from engineering definition through scheduling through execution through field feedback, is how Heavy Metal will out-build, out-adapt, and out-scale the traditional defense industrial base. MDP is scaling from a founding team to 70+ engineers across multiple U.S. sites. You will be joining early, working on hard problems with real operational stakes, and shaping how manufacturing software is built at Anduril from the ground up.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

As a Staff Full Stack Software Engineer on the ArsenalOS Deployment initiative, you will build the full-stack web applications that power daily planning, work assignment, and team-lead dashboards on the factory floor. You will develop offline-capable, mobile-friendly interfaces that factory operators depend on in network-constrained environments where reliability and usability are non-negotiable.
  
  
You will Own Maritime-specific manufacturing software requirements end to end. As well as the build-vs-extend decision for each ask. Today that's centered on shop-floor execution (scheduling capability in our MES); the mandate extends to whatever MES, ERP, and adjacent manufacturing capabilities Maritime needs next. Design, develop, deploy and operate across Maritime's factories.

  

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Build full-stack web applications for daily production planning, work assignment, and team-lead operational dashboards that drive real-time factory execution.
* Develop offline-capable and mobile-friendly interfaces designed for the factory floor, ensuring operators can work seamlessly in network-constrained or intermittent connectivity environments.
* Partner with manufacturing engineers and factory operators to understand production workflows and translate them into software requirements.
* Write production-quality code with comprehensive tests, participating in code review and architectural discussions.
* Design and implement robust offline-first architectures using service workers, local storage, and background sync to ensure application functionality regardless of network conditions.
* Build responsive, touch-optimized mobile interfaces that work on tablets and mobile devices in harsh manufacturing environments (gloves, low light, vibration).
* Architect and implement data synchronization strategies that handle conflict resolution and maintain data integrity between edge devices and backend systems.
* Deploy and operate your systems in factory environments, including edge compute clusters and OT networks.
* Leverage AI tooling (coding assistants, automation) in your development workflow and contribute to team engineering practices.
* Join an on-call rotation supporting production factory systems.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with backend engineers, data engineers, factory systems teams, and operations to ensure seamless integration with MES, data pipelines, and enterprise systems.
* Set technical direction and mentor junior engineers on best practices for building resilient, user-centered manufacturing software.

### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 8+ years of experience in a software engineering role building production systems, ideally in a fast-paced environment.
* Deep expertise in full-stack web development, with demonstrated mastery of both frontend and backend systems.
* Strong technical fluency in modern software architectures, APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD, and cloud or edge infrastructure.
* Proficiency with web-based technologies including JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, and modern web frameworks.
* Experience building offline-capable web applications using service workers, IndexedDB, local storage, and progressive web app (PWA) patterns.
* Experience building systems that must operate reliably under real-world operational constraints (high availability, low latency, or constrained environments).
* Experience working with large enterprise applications and platforms with high availability requirements.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer, Autonomy Verification and Validation
jobs.description:
Zoox is on an ambitious journey to develop a full-stack autonomous mobility solution for cities and safely deploy such a robotaxi solution. The System Design and Mission Assurance (SDMA) team plays a foundational role in the company's success, responsible for constructing the safety case and fail-operational design for our autonomous driving robots before public road deployment.

As a Validation and Verification Systems engineer at Zoox, you will be owning a highly cross-functional role spanning across program management, legal, Software, and Operations organizations. You will be part of a systems engineering organization that develops and deploys novel solutions to substantiate a safety case for autonomous driving. Zoox is building a purpose-built robotaxi. Your real-world and virtual tests will capture the full end-to-end performance, from the advanced AI systems through the custom vehicle platform.

You will be leading the creation of cutting-edge V&V methodologies, developing processes, writing comprehensive validation plans, reviewing verification and simulation results, and preparing reports needed to ensure the safety of the Autonomous software. You will be part of an organization with strong leadership and a transparent and respectful culture that will enable you to bring out your best potential. The role is highly visible and there are opportunities for career growth through demonstrated achievement.

### **In this role, you will:**

* Establish strategies and methodologies to Verify and Validate the Software stack with robust test coverage
* Work cross-functionally to develop detailed Simulation test plans to validate Autonomous features
* Design efficient test programs to achieve test coverage of requirements and scenarios, drawing on simulation, and analysis where possible
* Maintain traceability between requirements, test cases, and results
* Troubleshoot and debug issues in the field, and trace failures to correct subsystems
* Perform test data analysis and report test results. Define and develop automated data extraction tools to streamline analysis and reporting

### **Qualifications**

* B.S. or higher degree in Automotive Engineering, Aerospace, Robotics, Electrical, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering
* 6+ years of system engineering experience in the automotive, robotics, or aerospace industry
* Analytical skills and hands-on experience
* Cross-disciplinary background and curiosity
* Ability to grapple with ambiguity and collaborate with cross-functional teams

### **Bonus Qualifications**

* Experience developing integration or structured test plans and procedures for safety critical robotic systems and/or autonomous vehicles, especially ADAS systems like AEB.
* Familiarity with programming languages such as C or C++
* Experience with test scripting and data analysis languages (Python and SQL preferred)

**Base Salary Range**

There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position.Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long-term care insurance, long-term and short-term disability insurance, and life insurance.

**About Zoox**

Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter.

***A Final Note:***

*You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.*

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Title**
=============

Automation Engineer

**Job Description Summary**
===========================

**Job Description**
===================

At C&W Services, we live by the belief that Better Never Settles. We're dedicated to creating a positive impact globally, and we're looking for talented individuals to join our team.

**C&W Services provides compelling benefits, including:**

* Weekly Pay!
* Comprehensive Benefits that start on your first day!
* Advancement Opportunities!
* Training to work in a Cutting Edge Facility!
* A Safety First Culture!

**About the Role**:

The Automation Engineering Apprentice (AEA) will learn to focus on equipment troubleshooting and maintaining material handling equipment (MHE) such as conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply labeling systems, scales, HMI systems, and control cabinets. During on-the-job learning (OJL) you will work with complex high-performance manufacturing systems and will learn to analyze, troubleshoot, and repair systems to maintain process efficiency. jobs.description:
* Sunnyvale, CA, United States

### **Company Description**

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.

### **Job Description**

We’re looking for a Software Engineer who is passionate about building a modern, scalable Data as a Service (DaaS) platform that powers Intuitive’s Digital products and supports over 2,000 engineers across the organization. In this role, you will own and evolve critical components of our real-time and micro-batch data pipelines that power product development, internal tools, and analytics.

Your work will focus on enabling high-throughput, low-latency data delivery through streaming pipelines, dynamic transformations, and APIs, driving discoverability, accessibility, and actionable insights. You will help define the architecture and engineering practices that support self-service analytics and operational decision-making on scale.

As a catalyst for change, you will be at the forefront of reimagining how engineering teams consume and interact with data. Long-term success in this role means building robust, efficient systems and replacing legacy processes with modern solutions that allow teams to move faster, with greater confidence and autonomy.

**Responsibilities:**

* Design and build scalable, distributed Data as a Service that ingest, process, and serve data from robotics, manufacturing, engineering, and clinical sources in real time and batch modes.
* Develop and maintain robust APIs, data services, and tooling to provide internal teams with secure, efficient, and intuitive access to high-quality data.
* Partner with engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders to evolve data contracts and models that support emerging use cases and ensure semantic consistency.
* Implement CI/CD practices for data services, including automated testing for data quality, service reliability, and schema evolution.
* Championing a self-service data culture by building discoverable, well-documented data products and guiding teams toward empowered, autonomous data access.
* Act as a technical leader within the data domain driving best practices, mentoring teammates, and continuously improving how data is produced, shared, and consumed across the organization.

### **Qualifications**

**Qualifications:**

**Key Skills & Experience:**

* Solid quantitative background in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Math, or 3+ years of hands-on experience in a technically demanding role.
* Proficient in at least two major programming languages such as Python, Go, Scala, C++, or Java, with a strong understanding of software design and architecture.
* Proven experience building data pipelines and working with distributed systems using technologies like Apache Spark, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Snowflake, and Airflow.
* Strong collaborator who actively contributes to code reviews, system design discussions, sprint planning, and KPI evaluations to drive team excellence and technical quality.
* Minimum a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field.

**Bonus Points:**

* Experience working on Data Platform or Infrastructure Engineering teams.
* Hands-on experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Apache Airflow, Snowflake, and Terraform.
* Familiarity with CI/CD best practices for DataOps and deployment automation.

**About the Data Services Team:**

We are a rapidly growing organization made up of Software and Data Engineers, with a strong DevOps culture, focused on building a next-generation Data as a Service (DaaS) platform. We are seeking a strong technical lead who is passionate about designing scalable, real-time data systems that deliver high-quality, trusted data across the company.

Our platform leverages technologies such as Apache Kafka for real-time data ingestion, Apache Flink for stream processing and transformation, Snowflake for scalable warehousing, and AWS as our cloud backbone. We focus on serving data via APIs and event streams to enable on-demand access, analytics, and machine learning across product and engineering teams.

This is a newly formed group with a mandate to drive meaningful change by enabling fast, reliable, and consistent access to data. We aim to eliminate organizational silos and foster a strong culture of collaboration and ownership. If you see a high-leverage solution to a long-standing data problem, we support tearing down legacy systems and building the right solution provided you have a strong plan and the drive to make it happen.

### **Additional Information**

Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19. Details can vary by role.

The Robot Intelligence Lab at Samsung Research America is a new facility dedicated to advancing the field of robotics through cutting-edge research and development. The lab's mission is to develop advanced technologies to power intelligent robotic systems capable of manipulation, navigation, and complex reasoning for a variety of high-impact application areas. To achieve this mission, the lab collaborates closely with external entities such as universities, startups, and government labs, as well as with several Samsung Product and Advanced Research labs.

Samsung Research America is looking for a Senior Robotics Systems Engineer to own the end-to-end software architecture for our robot platform, driving technical decisions that shape how hardware and software integrate at scale. This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role: you won't inherit a mature codebase—you'll *build* the foundations that make it possible.

As an early team member, you'll work directly across software teams (reasoning, dexterity, perception, simulation) to integrate their work into a cohesive platform. You'll establish the architectural patterns, engineering practices, and infrastructure that allow rapid iteration today and maintainable growth tomorrow. This includes defining component interfaces, building CI/CD pipelines, containerizing environments, and implementing package management and deployment strategies—essentially, laying the technical groundwork for a production robotics system.

Samsung's unique advantage in the consumer electronics market and growing focus on AI and robotics will provide you with exciting technical challenges and a rewarding career experience. jobs.title: Senior Electrical Industrial Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Mytra:**

We’re creating an entirely new way to solve the most ubiquitous problem in industry - moving and storing material. We’re applying robotics and distributed software to create a new class of product for this $1T market. We’re focused on the supply chain industry first. The industry is in a massive bind with the continued growth of e-commerce, sharp rise in costs, and supply chain disruptions. What has been a “sleepy” industry for decades is now at the epicenter of sustaining the global economy.

**About the role:**
-------------------

Mytra is looking for a **Senior Electrical Controls Engineer** to design and develop the electrical control systems for our next generation of robotic factory automation. This role will own electrical designs from system architecture and component selection through panel design, prototype bring-up, system integration, and production.

You will work closely with electrical, mechanical, firmware, controls, safety, manufacturing, and test engineers to develop robust, scalable electrical systems that can move from prototype into production. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working across the full system—from electrical schematics and control panels to wiring, sensors, motor drives, embedded controls, PLCs, and debugging the machine on the floor.

**What We're Looking For:**
---------------------------

We're looking for someone who can own the electrical system rather than just a portion of the design. You should be comfortable moving between architecture discussions, electrical CAD, component selection, control-panel design, and hands-on debugging.

The ideal candidate has shipped automated equipment or robotic systems and understands the difference between getting a prototype working and developing a production-ready system. You should be comfortable working in a fast-moving environment, making engineering tradeoffs, and collaborating closely with engineers and technicians across the organization.

We are looking for an electrical engineer who can own the system from architecture through production and has strong hands-on experience with industrial automation, control panels, PLCs, and robotic systems.

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

* Lead the electrical architecture and design of automated systems within the pallet structural system
* Design industrial electrical control panels, including power distribution, controls, I/O, safety systems, and machine interfaces
* Develop electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, cable schedules, BOMs, and manufacturing documentation
* Work closely with safety engineers to support industrial functional safety controls
* Select and specifyPLCs, remote I/O, industrial PCs, motor/servo drives, power supplies, circuit protection, relays, contactors, sensors, and other electrical components
* Develop PLC and machine-control architectures, including I/O definitions and interfaces between electrical, controls, firmware, and mechanical systems
* Design AC/DC power distribution and 24VDC control systems, including appropriate circuit protection and power management
* Design and integrate motors, servo systems, actuators, sensors, encoders, safety devices, and other machine-level electrical components
* Develop machine safety circuits including E-stops, safety relays/PLCs, interlocks, light curtains, and other protective devices
* Develop and maintain standardized, modular electrical architectures that can be reused across multiple robotic systems
* Work with mechanical engineers on electrical enclosure, panel, cable routing, connector, harness, and machine integration requirements
* Build and bring up prototype control panels and electrical systems, troubleshoot wiring and integration issues, and support system commissioning
* Work directly with technicians, manufacturing, suppliers, and panel builders to transition designs into production.
* Participate in design reviews, electrical risk assessments, system validation, and root-cause analysis of electrical and system-level issues
* Support factory acceptance testing, system commissioning, and deployment of robotic systems
* Establish electrical engineering processes, standards, design guidelines, and best practices for Mytra's production systems
* Drive electrical designs from early prototypes through production, balancing performance, reliability, cost, manufacturability, and schedule

**Ideal Candidates**
--------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
* 5+ years of experience designing electrical systems for industrial automation, robotics, manufacturing equipment, or complex electromechanical products
* Strong experience with industrial control panel design and electrical schematics
* Experience with PLC-based control systems and industrial I/O architectures
* Experience selecting and integrating motor drives, servo systems, power supplies, circuit protection, relays, contactors, sensors, and safety components
* Experience with electrical CAD tools for creating schematics, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, and electrical documentation
* Strong understanding of AC/DC power distribution, 24VDC control systems, grounding, circuit protection, and electrical safety
* Experience creating electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, BOMs, cable schedules, and manufacturing documentation
* Hands-on experience bringing up, debugging, and troubleshooting automated machinery or robotic systems
* Experience working with mechanical, firmware/software, controls, manufacturing, and test engineering teams
* Experience taking electrical designs from prototype through production
* Strong troubleshooting and system-level problem-solving skills

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* Experience with robotics, automated material handling, or high-volume manufacturing equipment.
* Experience with industrial PLC platforms such as Siemens, Rockwell/Allen-Bradley, Beckhoff, or similar.
* Experience with EtherCAT, EtherNe

Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor-based products and coaxial and high-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. The Power Systems Engineer is a customer-facing technical role at the intersection of system-level power architecture and connector/cable interconnect engineering. Working directly with hyperscalers, GPU/CPU partners, infrastructure partners, and Rack Power ODMs to understand current and future power delivery architectures and turn that insight into connector and cable power solutions. The role sits between the customer's engineering teams and internal product development engineering, R&D, and applications engineering, acting as the primary technical liaison who gathers technical requirements, aligns architecture with product capability, and presents solutions back to the customer.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Technical Requirements:** Engage with customer engineering teams to capture requirements to develop power interconnect solutions.

* **Customer-facing solutioning:** Serve as the front-facing technical point of contact for power architecture discussions, presenting connector/cable solution options, trade-offs, and roadmap alignment directly to customer engineering teams.
* **Cross-functional alignment:** Partner with product engineering and manufacturing site to develop and deliver power interconnect solutions.
* **Specification development:** Develop technical requirement documents and specification inputs that drive new product development and design-in activities.

* **Industry Standards:** Track relevant industry standards and consortia (e.g., OCP, hyperscaler-specific specifications) that shape power delivery and interconnect roadmaps.
* **Voice of customer:** Deliver customer and market insight back into internal roadmap and new product development.
* Support senior team members in customer engagements.
* Build working knowledge of the company's connector and cable product portfolio as applied to power delivery use cases.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Master’s degree with 1+ years of experience in power connector, systems engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Foundational understanding of connector development and power architecture concepts.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable participating in customer-facing meetings alongside senior colleagues.

***Job Title: Senior Associate, Software Engineering***

***Job Number: 45882***

***Job Location: Yorba Linda, CA***

***Job Schedule: 4/10: Employees work 10 hour shifts 4 days a week***

**Job Description:**

IEC, Navigation Solutions delivers advanced military GPS and broader Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT) capabilities that support mission requirements across weapons systems, ground platforms, airborne assets, maritime systems, and space environments. Navigation Solutions products are engineered to provide resilient PNT performance for the warfighter operating in denied or degraded environments. This role directly ensures that GPS receivers and simulators maintain mission effectiveness when exposed to adversarial threats and operational challenges.

A key responsibility of this role is to develop and debug robust embedded software to fulfill strict performance requirements related to GPS user equipment. This role expands beyond coding, testing and debugging, and includes analysis of requirements, producing detailed documentation, conducting proof-of-concept evaluation of design alternatives, conducting code reviews, and other similar tasks.

Successful candidates perform complex professional software engineering assignments requiring advanced problem-solving skills. This requisition, and any potential offer, is contingent upon the award of government contracts and adherence to contract budgets.

**Essential Functions:**

  

* Actively contribute to embedded C/C++ development for GPS and related equipment, including integration and debugging on target hardware
* Develop high-quality documentation covering design details and demonstrating compliance to requirements
* Ability to obtain a SECRET clearance.

**Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s Degree in a Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or equivalent, and 2 years of prior relevant experience in the design and analysis of realtime embedded software.
* Master of Science or advanced degree preferred and 0-2 years of prior related experience.
* In lieu of a degree, a minimum of 6 years of prior related experience.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

  

* Exposure to modern GPS concepts including signal selection, acquisition and tracking, Position, Velocity, and Time (PVT) calculation, data demodulation, signal correction, jamming and spoofing
* Exposure to software development using Agile / Scrum methodologies
* Exposure to embedded system development in C/C++
* Experience in Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and related toolchains
* Familiar with Defense industry typical documentation and milestone reviews
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Work is performed on-site in Yorba Linda, with 4/10 schedule preferred. Additional work schedules of 5/8 or 9/80 are also considered.

Meta is seeking talented experienced engineers to join our teams in building cutting-edge products that connect billions of people around the world. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to work on complex technical problems, build new features, and improve existing products across various platforms, including mobile devices and web applications. Our teams are constantly pushing the boundaries of user experience, and we're looking for passionate individuals who can help us advance the way people connect globally. If you're interested in joining a world-class team of engineers and researchers to work on exciting projects that have significant impact, we encourage you to apply.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Infrastructure Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, design, operations, infrastructure) to build innovative application experiences
* Implement custom user interfaces using latest programming techniques and technologies
* Analyze and optimize code for quality, efficiency, and performance, and provide feedback to peers during code reviews
* Set direction and goals for teams, lead major initiatives, provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers, and help onboard new team members
* Architect efficient and scalable systems that drive complex applications
* Identify and resolve performance and scalability issues, and drive large efforts to reduce technical debt
* Work on a variety of coding languages and technologies
* Establish ownership of components, features, or systems with expert end-to-end understanding

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Experience utilizing data and analysis to explain technical problems and provide detailed feedback and solutions
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Demonstrated experience driving change within an organization and leading complex technical projects
* 8+ years of programming experience in a relevant language OR 4+ years experience with a PhD

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* 6+ years relevant experience building large-scale infrastructure applications or similar experience
* Experience improving quality through thoughtful code reviews, appropriate testing, proper rollout, monitoring, and proactive changes
* Experience in programming languages such as C, C++, or Java, and scripting languages such as Python, Javascript, or Hack
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. jobs.description:
**Systems Engineer**

We are on the front line of recruitment, enabling organizations to hire smarter and onboard faster. At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members.

Say hello to a rewarding career and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands.

**About First Advantage**

First Advantage (NASDAQ: FA) is a leading provider of global software and data in the HR technology industry. Enabled by proprietary technology and AI, First Advantage’s platforms, data, and APIs power comprehensive employment background screening, identity solutions, and verification services.

Headquartered in Atlanta, GA, we have an internationally distributed workforce of about 10,000 employees spanning 17 countries. With a strong emphasis on innovation, automation, and customer success, First Advantage empowers 80,000 organizations to modernize their hiring and onboarding processes on a global scale.

**What You'll Do**

The ideal **Systems Engineer** brings deep technical expertise across the Microsoft ecosystem (Entra ID, On-Prem AD, Exchange Hybrid, Intune/Autopilot), advanced scripting proficiency (PowerShell, Azure Automation, Microsoft Graph API), and hands-on experience integrating ITSM platforms like Jira Service Management (JSM).

We are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking GITS Systems & Automation Engineer to drive our IT operational transformation. In this role, you will bridge identity governance, cloud/hybrid infrastructure, and service management by designing and implementing zero-touch provisioning pipelines, automated Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) workflows, and AI/Virtual Agent self-service integrations.

**Responsibilities:**

**1. Identity & Access Lifecycle Automation (JML):**

* Design, build, and maintain end-to-end automated workflows for employee onboarding, role transitions, and offboarding across On-Prem AD, Entra ID, Exchange Online, and SaaS business applications.
* Implement dynamic group rules, attribute-based access control (ABAC), and Entra ID governance policies to ensure scalable, policy-driven access.
* Ensure strict UPN/primary SMTP synchronization and casing rules to eliminate duplicate cloud objects and sync errors.

**2. Hybrid Infrastructure & Cloud Administration:**

* Administer and optimize hybrid Active Directory and Microsoft 365 environments, including **Exchange Hybrid cutover/migrations, E5 license provisioning, Teams, and SharePoint.**
* Configure and maintain Microsoft Intune device compliance policies, configuration profiles, and Windows Autopilot zero-touch deployment pipelines**.**

**3. Scripting & Workflow Orchestration:**

* Author enterprise-grade, modular PowerShell scripts and Azure Automation Runbooks utilizing Managed Identities and Azure Key Vault for secure secret management.
* Build REST API integrations using Microsoft Graph API and webhooks to connect ITSM tools with identity platforms.

**4. Conversational AI & ITSM Integration:**

* Partner with IT leadership to integrate Virtual Agents / Conversational AI with Jira Service Management (JSM) to enable automated ticket triage, self-service access fulfillment, and Knowledge Base deflection.
* Build automated runbook triggers initiated from JSM service requests and approval gates.

**5. Security, Compliance & Governance:**

* Enforce Zero Trust principles using Conditional Access, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and Privileged Identity Management (PIM) / Just-In-Time (JIT) access.
* Conduct automated audits of mailboxes, privileged roles, distribution lists, and access logs to maintain audit readiness (SOX/ISO).

**What You Will Need to be Successful:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, computer science or a related field
* Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Systems Administration and IT Operations with a strong focus on identity management and automation.

**What You May Need to be Successful:**

  

* Microsoft Cloud & Hybrid Stack: Expert knowledge of Entra ID (Azure AD), Hybrid Active Directory, Group Policies (GPO), and Microsoft 365 (E5) Suite. Proficient in Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Exchange Hybrid / EAC, Conditional Access, and Entra PIM.
* Automation & Scripting: Advanced PowerShell scripting (modular scripting, error handling, remote execution). Hands-on experience with Azure Automation (Hybrid Workers, Runbooks) and Microsoft Graph API / REST APIs.
* ITSM & Workflow Tooling: Experience with Jira Service Management (JSM) automation rules, webhooks, and asset management. Exposure to Virtual Agents, AI Chatbots, or conversational self-service workflows.
* Security & Best Practices: Proven experience managing credentials securely (Azure Key Vault, enterprise password managers). Strong understanding of RBAC, least privilege, and compliance auditing standards.
* Preferred Certifications: SC-300 (Identity and Access Administrator Associate), MS-102 (Microsoft 365 Enterprise Administrator Expert), AZ-104 (Azure Administrator Associate).

**Why Join Us at First Advantage?**

At First Advantage, team members are united around a noble purpose: helping organizations to safeguard their workplaces and manage risk. The company’s culture is shaped by its core values — Authenticity, Curiosity, Integrity, Teamwork, Customer-Inspired — empowering team members to bring their best ideas forward, collaborate across departments, and make a real impact.

* Employee Impact Groups

* Mentorship Advantage Program
* SOAR, award-winning manager development program

Additional benefits offered include:

  

* Competitive Salary Package
* HMO Benefits

Inference is the engine that powers AI, and Groq was built from the silicon up to deliver the world's fastest inference at scale. GroqMetal is building the infrastructure platform that turns large-scale physical compute into a reliable, isolated, customer-consumable AI infrastructure. You will lead the design of a Kubernetes-based software platform focused on large-scale AI training and inference workloads. You will be a key technical leader in building the systems that turn cutting-edge physical infrastructure into a stable product.

* **Excellence Is The Standard**: High performance isn’t just encouraged, it’s the baseline. And it’s contagious.
  

  

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you!

**About Varda**
---------------

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. **Varda's W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.**

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

**About This Role**
-------------------

The **Senior Spacecraft Mission Software Engineer** is responsible for Varda's critical ground segment software, and the platform it runs on which enables spacecraft operations. We operate at the intersection of telemetry and commanding, data acquisition and distribution, mission control interfaces, simulation and test automation, with reliable deployment across lab, test range, and mission operations environments. **SENIOR ELECTRICAL ENGINEER**

**Designing next-gen gaming for fighter pilots. Except the jet is real, the G's are real, and the mission is real.**

Red 6 is a startup doing something that's never been done: bringing fully immersive 3D synthetic worlds into real aircraft in real flight. Pilots see the actual sky around them, with realistic adversaries, wingmen, terrain, and tankers layered into their view in real time. It replaces decades-old training methods that depend on costly live aircraft or ground simulators. Warfighters get more realistic, repeatable training at a fraction of the cost, and they show up to the fight better prepared.

**Analog IC Validation Job Description**

The Analog IC Validation team is responsible for defining, developing, and utilizing test procedures to ensure that the products designed by Broadcom meet all applicable industry standards and perform as expected in their intended applications. Analog IC Validation engineers work with the other engineering departments (Analog designers, hardware, and software) to validate and debug new products in a lab environment. This team is continuously working with state-of-the-art test equipment, on leading-edge storage silicon, and developing tests for an ever-evolving high-speed serial industry.

**Responsibilities can include:**

* Architect characterization procedures and tests geared towards ensuring compliance with SAS, SATA, PCIe, NVMe, DDR4, and Onfi standards.
* Review and execute robust validation test plans on prototype silicon
* Work in parallel with Firmware development, High-speed I/O designers, and Digital IC design teams as part of the pre/post-silicon validation process
* Develop Python scripts to control test equipment and automate various validation tasks.
* Develop host software tools and applications for low-level system validation
* Develop SI simulation models for customer consumption
* Work with the board development team to define evaluation board test features
* Partner with board development teams to identify and resolve signal quality issues associated with the layout of evaluation and production cards
* Support design partners bring up and resolve signal integrity related customer issues

  + Drive technical debug and the resolution of issues encountered at the system level.
  + Propose creative workarounds and implement solutions to complex problems.
* Effectively present technical information to teams of engineers.

* Ability to write and debug programs written in Python with some experience in C and MATLAB
* Experience developing/debugging automated test scripts preferably in Python

We are seeking an experienced Optical Systems Engineer with expertise in lasers, optical systems, and hands-on laboratory development to mature advanced optical technologies from early-stage R&D prototypes into robust, field-deployable systems. You'll combine your strong technical knowledge of laser systems, optical architectures, opto-mechanical integration, alignment, controls, and optical measurements with the ability to lead engineers and technicians through system development, integration, testing, and transition to production. This position serves as a critical bridge between R&D and engineering and product development, translating emerging technologies into reliable, manufacturable, maintainable, and field-ready systems with progressively higher Technology Readiness Levels (TRLs). The successful candidate will work directly in the laboratory, troubleshoot complex optical systems, develop experimental methods, guide technical teams, and establish processes for transitioning research concepts into operational systems across Laboratory, Engineering, R&D, and Product and Field environments.

  

**What You'll Work On:**

* Lead the design, integration, characterization, and testing of complex optical and laser systems.
* Define system architectures, requirements, specifications, and performance metrics.
* Develop test configurations, and verification methods.
* Troubleshoot and improve optical subsystems and integrated systems with R&D team

Join us. The world can't wait.

  

**You Have:**

jobs.description:
**The future of aerospace and defense starts here.**

Ursa Major was founded to revolutionize how America and its allies access and apply high-performance propulsion, from hypersonics to solid rocket motors, satellite maneuvering and launch. We design and deliver propulsion and defense systems that solve the most urgent and critical national security demands.

Ursa Major is seeking a **Staff Systems Engineer** within the SMS Systems Engineering Team to creatively drive safety, reliability, and risk management solutions for our propulsion systems. This role is responsible for the safe design and operation of our rocket motors to ensure they meet the highest standards of performance and safety. You will work cross-functionally with systems engineering, mission operations, design, test, manufacturing, and program teams to develop robust product safety strategies and ensure successful mission execution. You will also own the relationship between Ursa Major and DoD Safety Review Boards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement mission assurance processes to ensure product reliability, safety, and performance

* Own the Ursa Major relationship with branch specific Weapon Safety Boards and assist with authoring & presenting motor qualification plans & test reports for WSESRB, JSWRB, etc. approval

* Own technical inputs to Interim Hazard Classification (IHC) & Final Hazard Classification (FHC) planning, execution and approval for motor shipments and fielding

* Establish and maintain best practices for risk register management across different programs and products; present both internally and externally as required

* Work with design and product teams to find creative and efficient solutions to engineering challenges that ultimately reduce product risk; develop system safety requirements for product design

* Perform system-level failure assessments (Failure Modes & Effects Analysis (FMEA), Fault Hazard Analysis (FHA), etc.) to inform system design and risk tracking

* Establish plans for end-to-end product lifecycle, including but not limited to any required handling restrictions, demilitarization, and disposal

* Assist with flight test range safe execution planning

* Lead failure investigations

* Perform reliability assessments for motor products

* Other duties as assigned

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering or a related field

* 8+ years of experience in system safety, mission assurance, or systems engineering

* Experience with solid rocket motors, ignition systems, propulsion systems, launch vehicles, or defense aerospace programs

* Experience with risk analysis methods (FMEA, FHA, probabilistic risk assessment)

* Experience with aerospace industry standards (MIL-STD-882, etc.)

* Experience working with cross-functional teams, interfacing with internal/external customers

* Demonstrated ability to break down complex problems, strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced development environment

* **This position requires that the employee be eligible and maintain eligibility for a Secret Clearance**

  

**Desired Experience**

* Master's degree in a relevant technical discipline

* Comprehensive knowledge of systems engineering processes, including requirements development and verification

* Hands-on experience with testing and validation of high-performance hardware

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

We have an exciting opportunity for a **Robotics Software Engineer** at UL Research Institutes , based in our Skokie, IL office.

  

The **Robotics Software Engineer** will design and maintain the software infrastructure that connects laboratory automation, robotics, scientific instruments, data systems, and decision tools into integrated autonomous workflows. The role will work closely with scientists, automation engineers, robotics engineers, and data scientists to build scalable, reliable software for experimental orchestration and closed-loop research.

  

**UL Research Institutes:**

At UL Research Institutes (ULRI) , we expand the boundaries of safety science to create a more secure and sustainable world. For more than a century, we have studied the unintended consequences of innovation, designed solutions to mitigate risk and shared our findings with academia, scientists, manufacturers, and policymakers across industries. We identify critical safety and sustainability issues, asking the tough questions because we believe a safer world begins with knowledge.

  

Build a safer, more secure, and sustainable future with us. Join us and work with our Materials Discovery Research Institute teams who conduct the research required to produce that knowledge and put into practice.

  

**Materials Discovery Research Institute:**

The Materials Discovery Research Institute (MDRI) works to develop and deploy new materials with the potential to address current global safety challenges. Pursuing materials that will help produce transformational safety breakthroughs, MDRI harnesses the power of advanced computing and high-throughput experimental methods to create innovative materials that will produce resilience for a sustainable future and protect individual and societal health.

  

We focus on today’s critical challenges, working to create new and better materials that will support renewable energy and environmental sustainability. Among our top priorities is research into materials capable of carbon capture and energy storage, with an eye toward reducing the adverse impacts of humanity’s reliance upon fossil fuel resources and enabling a transition to renewable energy sources.

  

Above all, our research builds on our commitment to a safer, more sustainable future.

**What you’ll learn and achieve:**

**As the Robotics Software Engineer, you will play a key role in the rapid growth of UL** **as you:**

* Develop and maintain software integrations for laboratory instruments, robotics, and automation platforms.
* Design and implement scalable APIs and reusable interfaces for communication across heterogeneous systems.
* Build workflow orchestration for multi-step experimental processes across synthesis, sample handling, characterization, and analysis.
* Develop and maintain sample tracking, metadata, and lineage capabilities to support experimental traceability.
* Implement scheduling, system-state management, error handling, and recovery capabilities to support reliable unattended operation.
* Integrate systems using APIs, OPC-UA, Ethernet/IP, Modbus TCP, serial communication, and related protocols.
* Collaborate with Data Science team to support integration with scientific databases, data platforms, ML models, and decision tools.
* Develop monitoring, logging, dashboards, and diagnostic tools in conjunction with Data Science team.
* Apply modern software engineering practices including Git, testing, CI/CD, documentation, and containerization.
* Troubleshoot and resolve software issues, implementing proactive solutions to enhance system stability.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to translate laboratory needs into scalable software solutions.
Perform other duties as assigned.  

  

**What you’ll experience working at UL Research Institutes:** We have pursued our mission of working for a safer, more secure, and sustainable world for nearly 130 years, embedding conscientious stewardship into everything we do.

**Working at Abbott**

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

* RESTful web services, Relational Databases (Postgres, SQL Server), and ORM technologies (JPA2, Hibernate, Entities Framework).

* Strong knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 and FHIR.

* Experience using Spring Boot or Spring to support Microservices
* Experience using Maven
* Experience using Kafka or other queuing systems

* 15+ years of automotive engineering experience developing C and C++ real-time embedded controls.
* Experience with Functional Safety (ISO 26262) and Cyber Security (ISO 21434)
* Ability to develop automated test & evaluation scripts in Python.
* Demonstrated, hands-on experience with design, implementation, problem solving, and validating complex control software for embedded systems.
* Experience with integration and diagnostics of control modules, sensors, and actuators within embedded control systems.
* Experience using Visual Studio or VS Code Integrated Development Environment (IDE).
* Experience with GitHub for software version control & change management.
* Experience with software quality processes & tools, such as CMMI, SPICE, AutoSAR.

Preferred Experience:

* ISO 26262 Certification.
* ISO 21434 Certification.

**Your Job**

As the Security Platform Engineer, you will engineer, operate, automate, and continuously improve the network security platforms that protect Georgia-Pacific's IT and OT environments, starting with the enterprise firewall platform across more than 150 locations. You will translate security standards into practical, well-governed policy and own the platform lifecycle, from request intake and change control through upgrades, monitoring, and support. This role will partner with Cyber Operations, Infrastructure & Site Reliability, Process Control, Koch shared services, and vendors to deliver secure connectivity and approved projects from design through go-live. You will also apply automation and data to reduce manual effort, rule sprawl, and operational risk while sustaining the reliability our manufacturing operations depend on.

**This role will be based in our Atlanta GP HQ or our Wichita Koch HQ with an expectation of three (3) days in the office per week.**

**Our Team**

The Cyber Security team within Georgia-Pacific is focused on managing risk across IT and OT environments by setting security standards and building the platforms, processes, and automation that put them into practice. Our goal is to provide valuable insights and dependable capabilities to business partners, enabling profitable, risk-based cyber security decisions. The team works collaboratively with Cyber Operations, Infrastructure & Site Reliability, Process Control and operations teams, Koch and shared-service partners, and third-party providers to protect critical systems, simplify how secure connectivity is requested and delivered, and drive sustainable operational outcomes.

BAE Systems is seeking an Electrical Engineer with 3 to 6 years of experience to support the design, integration, qualification, production, and sustainment of the AN/SPN-50(V)1 Shipboard Air Traffic Radar (SATR) system. The AN/SPN-50(V)1 provides shipboard air traffic control surveillance capability for aircraft identification, sequencing and separation, airspace containment, safety alerting, weather processing, and landing guidance in naval aviation environments.
  
The selected engineer will apply practical electrical engineering experience across RF and radar performance assessment, digital signal processing, target identification parameters, electrical power interfaces, thermal and environmental stability, built-in test, diagnostics, reliability metrics, and system-level verification. The role requires close collaboration with systems, RF, software, mechanical, manufacturing, test, quality, supplier, and naval integration teams to deliver a rugged, reliable, maintainable shipboard radar capability for demanding maritime operations.
  
The successful candidate is a detail-oriented electrical engineer who can work independently while collaborating effectively across disciplines. They bring strong engineering judgment, practical problem-solving skills, curiosity, and a commitment to delivering reliable radar capability that supports naval aviation operations.
  
The work environment is a rapid development environment as part of a multi-disciplinary team of engineers who designs, develops, evaluates, verifies, and provides in-service engineering support for the Navy's Aircraft Launch and Recovery system.
