------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

The Senior Director, Platform Engineering will define, build, and scale the technical foundation beneath Signet Jewelers' eCommerce storefronts and the order management estate. This leader will own solution architecture, cloud platform direction, AI in the software development lifecycle, build and release pipelines, the integration platforms, environment and performance engineering, edge delivery, and security engineering across the commerce and order management portfolio.

The role supports an operating model of central standards and federated delivery by ensuring platform capabilities are built as reusable, governed, secured, production-ready services used across every brand rather than solved separately by each delivery team.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Define and own the enterprise solution architecture for commerce and order management, including current state and future state views, domain reference architectures, and one set of standards applied across all storefronts.
* Build and scale platform engineering capabilities, including reusable services, shared APIs, integration frameworks, orchestration patterns, developer tooling, templates, and production-grade components used across multiple delivery teams and brands.
* Own cloud platform direction on AWS, and own AI in the software development lifecycle, including the tooling standard, the cost per team, and the measures that show whether it is working.
* Define and mature build and release pipelines, CI/CD, DevSecOps, test automation, and the integration platform so there is one release path rather than one per team.
* Own environment management, performance engineering, edge delivery, and pre-render, including capacity, readiness, and stability through peak trading.
* Establish engineering standards, platform guardrails, reference implementations, and reusable accelerators that enable secure, scalable, interoperable, and cost-effective delivery.
* Lead security engineering as the engineering counterpart to the Information Security function, embedding policy and controls into pipelines, environments, and platform services.
* Lead a permanent team of engineers and architects, including a Director leading the architecture practice, and direct the contract architecture, DevOps, and environments capacity onshore and offshore.
* Own the partner relationships and the standards those partners work to, with a view on what is better held internally over time.
* Provide senior technical leadership to transformation programs and brand initiatives, and influence senior stakeholders by evaluating emerging technology and making transparent trade-offs across scalability, risk, performance, cost, speed, and business value.
* Partner with Information Security, Data, Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, and business technology leaders to embed governance, security, compliance, and cost optimization directly into engineering workflows and platform services.

**POSITION QUALIFICATIONS**:

* 15 or more years of progressive technology leadership experience across software engineering, platform engineering, architecture, cloud, or enterprise technology organizations.
* 7 or more years leading large-scale engineering teams responsible for platform engineering, cloud platforms, architecture practices, or production technology capabilities.
* Proven experience building and scaling platforms, including reusable services, shared capabilities, APIs, integration frameworks, developer tooling, and production-grade systems used across multiple teams or business units.
* Hands-on experience owning environments, release pipelines, and performance engineering, not architecture and design alone.
* Experience leading architects and engineers who do not report directly to the role, with influence across teams embedded in delivery.
* Experience moving capability from a systems integrator or managed service back in house, including deciding what stays outsourced and holding the standard through the transition.
* Experience in high-volume consumer eCommerce, retail, or another business with a seasonal traffic peak and a change freeze around it.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Preferred experience in a multi-brand or multi-storefront commerce estate operating in more than one country.
* Preferred experience with a move toward headless or composable commerce on an established platform.

**Technical Skills:**

* Commerce platforms: SAP Commerce (Hybris), composable and headless commerce patterns
* Front end: Angular, Spartacus, server side rendering, pre-render for crawler and agent traffic, full stack engineering
* Order management: IBM Sterling Order Management or comparable enterprise OMS
* Cloud: AWS, cloud native architecture, containers, Kubernetes
* Integration: MuleSoft, API design and management, event driven patterns
* Product and enterprise data: Informa

jobs.title: Electronics Hardware Design Engineer (PCB)
jobs.description:
**About Austin Sensing Company**
--------------------------------

Austin Sensing Company builds radar, acoustic, and RF sensors for defense, public safety, critical infrastructure, and autonomous systems. We design and manufacture our hardware in Austin, Texas, with a focus on making high-performance sensing reliable, affordable, and widely available.

**About the Role**
------------------

We’re hiring an Electronics Hardware Design Engineer to design the circuit boards behind our sensing systems. You’ll own designs from requirements and component selection through schematic capture, PCB layout, board bring-up, validation, and production.

You’ll work closely with RF, FPGA, embedded systems, and mechanical engineers to build boards that perform reliably and can be manufactured consistently. We’re looking for someone who can make sound design decisions, debug their own hardware, and carry a board through multiple revisions into a finished product.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Design digital, analog, and mixed-signal circuits for sensor interfaces, processing, communications, and power distribution.
* Own component selection, schematic capture, PCB layout, and manufacturing documentation.
* Define board stackups, placement, routing constraints, grounding, and power distribution with attention to signal integrity and noise.
* Integrate microcontrollers, processors, FPGAs, memory, data converters, and communications interfaces.
* Work with RF engineers on interfaces between RF circuitry and supporting electronics.
* Bring up new boards and verify power rails, clocks, interfaces, and functionality.
* Diagnose failures using measurements, schematics, and controlled tests. Identify root causes and implement fixes.
* Evaluate power consumption, thermal behavior, and electrical margins across operating conditions.
* Design for manufacturability and testability, including programming access, test points, and production test requirements.
* Work with manufacturing and suppliers to resolve assembly issues, qualify component alternatives, and improve board yield.
* Maintain design files, bills of materials, revision history, and validation results.

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

* Experience designing PCBs from initial requirements through bring-up and production.
* Proficiency in Altium Designer or a comparable PCB design tool.
* Strong understanding of analog and digital electronics, power supplies, grounding, and circuit protection.
* Experience designing multilayer boards and applying signal integrity and power integrity principles.
* Familiarity with embedded processors, FPGAs, memory, and peripheral interfaces.
* Hands-on debugging skills using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and electronic loads.
* Experience preparing board fabrication and assembly files and reviewing designs with manufacturers.
* The ability to explain design tradeoffs and work through issues with firmware, RF, and mechanical engineers.
* Careful documentation and a willingness to take responsibility for a design through production.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Experience with radar, RF, acoustic, or other sensing hardware.
* Experience with high-speed interfaces such as DDR, Ethernet, USB, PCIe, or JESD204.
* Experience with low-noise analog circuits, ADCs, DACs, and sensor signal conditioning.
* Familiarity with EMI/EMC testing and improving designs based on test results.
* Experience designing for outdoor environments, temperature extremes, and electrical transients.
* Experience supporting production testing and troubleshooting field failures.
* A degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or a related field.

**Benefits**
------------

* 401(k)
* Insurance benefits
* Lunch and dinner served daily

jobs.title: Production Systems Engineer, Fleet AI Systems

This role sits at the intersection of large-scale AI compute systems and production engineering, supporting the hardware and software stack that powers Meta's AI training and inference workloads across tens of thousands of accelerators and servers. You will drive the strategy for fleet health, automated diagnostics, and lifecycle management of AI-optimized hardware, partnering closely with hardware design, silicon, software, and data center operations teams to ensure our AI systems are production-ready and operating at peak efficiency.  
  
  

### **Production Systems Engineer, Fleet AI Systems Responsibilities:**

* Define and drive the long-term technical strategy for fleet health monitoring, automated remediation, and lifecycle management of AI compute infrastructure at hyperscale
* Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning hardware design, firmware, systems software, and data center operations to bring new AI server platforms from pre-production validation through mass deployment
* Architect and oversee development of large-scale test automation frameworks for AI accelerator systems, covering GPU, TPU, and custom silicon configurations across diverse fleet topologies
* Establish organizational standards for root cause analysis methodologies, failure mode classification, and escalation workflows for AI system incidents at fleet scale
* Drive vendor and partner engagement on hardware specifications, firmware quality, and test methodology improvements to continuously raise the reliability bar for AI infrastructure
* Develop and champion data-driven visibility platforms that surface fleet health signals, predictive failure indicators, and capacity risk across AI training and inference clusters
* Lead ambiguous, high-impact investigations into systemic hardware and software failures affecting AI workload availability, producing durable solutions and documented learnings
* Mentor and provide technical direction to other engineers across the production systems organization, shaping engineering practices and raising the collective capability of the team
* Collaborate with capacity engineering and AI platform teams to translate fleet reliability requirements into hardware procurement, qualification, and deployment criteria
* Influence the roadmap of internal tooling and automation systems to reduce mean time to detection and resolution for AI fleet incidents at scale

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 12+ years of experience in production systems engineering, server hardware support, or infrastructure reliability engineering at hyperscale
* 12+ years of experience troubleshooting and root-causing failures across the full hardware and software stack, including CPUs, accelerators, memory, networking, storage, firmware, and operating systems
* Experience leading large-scale technical programs across hardware, firmware, and software engineering organizations with demonstrated organizational impact
* Experience designing and implementing automated diagnostics, test frameworks, or remediation systems for large server fleets
* Experience with Linux systems administration and scripting or programming in Python or equivalent languages for infrastructure tooling

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting AI training or inference infrastructure, including GPU clusters, high-speed interconnects such as InfiniBand or RoCE, and AI accelerator hardware at fleet scale
* Experience engaging directly with silicon vendors or ODMs on firmware qualification, failure analysis, and hardware specification development for AI compute systems
* Experience in post-production hyperscale environments managing full hardware lifecycle progressions for AI or HPC server platforms
* Experience with predictive fleet health modeling, telemetry pipelines, or data visualization platforms applied to large-scale hardware operations

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. jobs.title: Senior Lead Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
As **International Motors** continues to grow in San Antonio, we are expanding our production operations with the introduction of a night production shift. The night shift is **Monday through Thursday from 5:30 PM to 4:00 AM**, with production planned to begin in early 2027. This is a salaried position supporting a manufacturing operation. This may require working outside normal production hours, including extended shifts, production startup activities, recovery efforts, and occasional weekend support based on operational requirements.

**Shift Differential:** 10% differential upon transitioning to Night Shift work schedule.

We are seeking experienced **Senior Lead Controls Engineers - Night Shift** to provide technical leadership and hands-on support for our night shift manufacturing operations. This position serves as the primary escalation point for complex automation and controls issues affecting production equipment, material handling systems, robotics, and plant-wide control systems.

The ideal candidate is a highly skilled automation professional with extensive experience in Rockwell Automation platforms, Ignition SCADA, industrial networking, robotics, and troubleshooting high-volume manufacturing systems. This role requires strong technical leadership, rapid decision-making, and the ability to support multiple production areas in a fast-paced environment.

* Lead troubleshooting efforts for automation-related production disruptions.
* Provide rapid response and root cause analysis for controls, electrical, network, robotics, and system integration issues.
* Support production, maintenance, quality, and operations teams in resolving equipment failures and process abnormalities.
* Minimize downtime through effective diagnostic and corrective action practices.

  + FactoryTalk software applications

  + Fanuc robotics systems

* Analyze downtime trends and develop permanent corrective actions.
* Lead modernization and upgrade projects for aging automation systems.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer I
jobs.description:
**ABOUT FIREFLY AEROSPACE**
===========================

**Firefly Aerospace is a space and defense technology company that enables our world to launch, land, and operate in space – anywhere, anytime. As the partner of choice for critical space missions, Firefly is the only commercial company to launch a satellite to orbit with 24-hour notice and the only company to achieve a successful Moon landing. Our launch vehicles, lunar landers, and orbital vehicles provide government and commercial customers with full mission services from low Earth orbit to the Moon and beyond. Headquartered in north Austin, Texas, Firefly is looking for passionate, hardworking innovators to join our team and help fuel our successful trajectory into space.**


As an end-to-end responsive space company, Firefly Aerospace is on a mission to enable our world to launch, land, and operate in space – anywhere, anytime. Our small- to medium-lift launch vehicles, lunar landers, and orbital vehicles allow us to service the entire lifecycle of government and commercial missions from low Earth orbit to the Moon and beyond. We utilize carbon composite structures, patented propulsion technologies, and common components across our vehicles to iterate quickly, improve reliability, and deliver payloads at a lower cost.

**SUMMARY**

Firefly Electrical Engineers in the Interconnect team are responsible for developing the electrical wiring interconnect systems (EWIS) that distribute power and electrical signals within avionics hardware, instrumentation, and payloads. In this role, you will work in small, collaborative groups through all stages of the component and system design, manufacturing, and testing. Additionally, you will take ownership of your projects and collaborate with the team to conduct the design, analysis, manufacturing, testing, and final integration of components on launch vehicles and spacecraft.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop and integrate electrical wiring interconnect system (EWIS) designs on launch vehicles and spacecraft.
* Understand and implement industry guidelines and requirements for development and design of wire harnesses.
* Generate schematics, wire diagrams, harness 3D CAD routing, 2D assembly drawings, technical documentation, and reports to support flight, qualification, and test lab harness assemblies.
* Coordinate requirements and interfaces between engineering disciplines, production, and integration.
* Make development decisions based on technical merit, risk, cost, schedule, and/or quality assurance.

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. The Advanced Airborne RF Sensors department within the Space and Airborne Systems Engineering and Test Capability (SE&TC) Center seeks talented Systems Engineers. Our team located in McKinney, Texas, integrates hardware and software, develops test plans and procedures, debugs and evaluates system functions and interfaces, and verifies system requirements in support of final sell-off to the customer. We put our systems together, exercise them in the lab or in the field, measure and analyze performance, and make sure our products work the first time and every time. You'll be expected to collaborate across functional disciplines and partners to implement solutions. In this role, you'll get to know a little bit about every aspect of the system and have a direct hand in making it all work together supporting teams of engineers engaged in integration and test efforts.

* Maintain engineering databases
* Resolve and coordinate system technical solutions with Engineering teams
* Participate in periodic team meetings, interface teleconference meetings, working group meetings
* Support associated with implementing process requirements

**Qualifications You Must Have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM)
* Experience with tools, such as Microsoft Office, MATLAB or Python, for data analysis and automation.
* Experience with troubleshooting technical issues with electronics in an academic or internship setting, including the use of common commercial test equipment (oscilloscope, spectrum analyzer, etc.).

Experience may be obtained through on-the-job experience, research, coursework, or projects.

* Experience with Radar or RF engineering.

* Prior internship, co-op, or work experience.

This role will lead the development of AI-powered mobile experiences for the retail industry. You will partner with the product owner, subject matter experts, and customers to translate requirements into working software. * Build and maintain agent harnesses that connect AI models with context, tools, memory, permissions, and workflows. Support multi-step execution, task interruptions, recovery, and human approvals.
* Select, integrate, and evaluate AI models for reasoning, tool use, and vision. Optimize inference quality, latency, reliability, and cost across cloud and edge environments.
* Develop Android applications for retail handhelds and tablets, including adaptive interfaces, voice, camera, scanning, and payments. Connect applications securely to enterprise systems through APIs, events, and adapters.
* Establish engineering practices for AI-assisted coding, code review, automated testing, security, continuous integration, and releases. Ensure generated code is verified, and the software can be monitored and supported.
Mentor engineers, review designs and code, and lead technical issue resolution. Turn recurring customer requirements into reusable capabilities that support a maintainable, scalable commercial product.

Experience working with customers, customer IT, or customer-facing engineers to develop features and resolve technical issues. Practical use of AI-assisted development tools is required; retail technology experience is preferred.

jobs.description:
**Job ID: 9802**  
**Date Posted:** **October 14, 2026**  
  
Join the Space Dynamics Laboratory (SDL) team, where you'll contribute to groundbreaking innovations! SDL is a University Affiliated Research Corporation that performs cutting edge research and development for the Space Force and associated government agencies, specializing in developing new and untested space-based technologies. We are seeking a GNC Controls Engineer to join our Strategic & Military Space Division and lead the development, test, and deployment of control systems for satellites and space-based components. The ideal candidate would have experience leading the design of satellite control systems including analysis, requirements derivation, algorithms, electrical, and mechanical, as well as contribute to teams working software, and systems engineering. This is an opportunity to play a strong technical design and leadership role and oversee controller designs in support of important, space-based US government missions.  
  
The Strategic & Military Space Division delivers advanced satellite and sensor systems that support the Department of Defense and the Intelligence Community. Our division is a key component of national security, providing technological solutions and expert mission support. Become part of a team dedicated to making a tangible contribution to our nation’s defense capabilities.  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Owns the controller component of a major spacecraft subsystem (e.g., Attitude Determination and Control System (ADCS), propulsion, or gimbaled instruments) on satellites developed by SDL or external vendors
* Develops and maintains a comprehensive, multidisciplinary understanding of the owned component, including its design, functionality, interfaces, and integration within the broader spacecraft system
* Develops, interprets, and manages technical requirements to ensure the component meets mission objectives and overall system requirements
* Oversees controller and associated avionics development activities to ensure compliance with technical requirements, performance expectations, and program objectives.
* Collaborates across engineering disciplines to ensure component designs, interfaces, and implementations meet the rigorous performance and reliability standards required for spaceflight
* Performs design changes and analysis as needed
* Tracks issues using JIRA and works with programs to implement improvements
* Participates in mission and systems level program reviews providing technical expertise, design assessments, and status updates
* Prepares, reviews and presents technical documentation, including analyses, design documentation, development plans, and other engineering deliverables

**Required Qualifications:**

* Master’s or Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering, Controls Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent qualifications and experience
* At least 7 years of experience in controller design and implementation, including a minimum of 4 years of experience serving as a component (i.e., box) owner
* Demonstrated experience designing controllers for aerospace applications
* Experience overseeing the full controller development lifecycle, including algorithms, modeling, electrical design, software development, mechanical design, systems engineering, integration, and checkout
* Experience integrating controllers into larger products or systems as a subsystem-level component
* Experience designing and implementing high bandwidth real time control systems
* Experience developing, documenting, and overseeing the implementation and verification of requirements for controllers and related aerospace systems
* Experience using MATLAB/Simulink for controller design, modeling, simulation, and technical analysis
* Working knowledge of classical spacecraft guidance, navigation, and control (GNC) principles
* Working knowledge of current hardware technologies and controller design approaches used in space systems
* Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information effectively, both verbally and in writing, with program management, customers, contractors, and cross-functional engineering teams
* U.S. citizenship with the ability to obtain a government security clearance
* Ability to travel occasionally to contractor and customer facilities

  
**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering with a concentration in Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) or Controls, or a Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering with a background in aerospace engineering
* At least 10 years of experience in space-based control systems, including a minimum of 5 years of experience serving as a component (i.e., box) owner
* Experience in one or more of the following technical areas:
  + Propulsion
  + Astrodynamics / Orbital Mechanics
  + Rendezvous and Proximity Operations (RPO)
  + Attitude Dynamics and Controls (ADC)
  + Spacecraft Navigation / Orbit Determination
  + Spacecraft Guidance / Optimization
  + Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) Simulation and Test
* Experience with Atlassian tools, including Confluence, JIRA, and Bitbucket
* Knowledge of software implementation on FPGAs
* Experience with software development using C++
* Active Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) clearance
* Experience developing controllers for the Department of War (DoW) or other government agencies

  
**Salary Range**

* $105,000 - $180,000
  + Salary commensurate on education and relevant experience

We are looking for innovative software engineers who excel at building advanced engineering toolsets for the design and analysis of solid rocket motors. Your software will be used directly by propulsion engineers to design and analyze the next generation of space launch and national defense rockets.

You will join a multidisciplinary team of software engineers, working in close collaboration to design, implement, and support modeling and simulation (M&S) tools. These tools enhance our engineering organization’s ability to design and analyze solid rocket motors, driving greater performance, improved process efficiency, and continued innovation.

This position works on a 9/80 schedule, with every other Friday off. This is a fully on‑site role at our Promontory, UT facility.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, implement, and maintain modeling and simulation software to support advanced engineering analysis of solid rocket motor designs.
* Ensure high‑quality software development and deployment practices, including testing, documentation, configuration management, and troubleshooting, to deliver robust tools that meet user needs.
* Collaborate closely with engineers and subject matter experts to translate technical requirements into functional, user‑friendly software tools.
* Develop intuitive user interfaces and workflows so design and analysis engineers can configure and run complex simulations efficiently.
* Optimize numerical algorithms and data processing pipelines for performance, scalability, and reliability.
* Provide technical support and guidance to end‑users, ensuring tools are properly integrated into their workflows and continuously improved based on feedback.
* Contribute to continuous improvement efforts by assessing current practices, recommending enhancements, and driving efficiency in engineering processes.
* Experience using modern software development tools (e.g., Git, issue tracking, unit testing frameworks).
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to learn new technical domains quickly.

Basic Qualifications for Level 2:

* Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field with 2+ years of professional software development experience, OR a Master’s degree in a STEM field.
* Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government DoD Secret security clearance.
* Proficiency in Python or C++, including experience delivering production‑quality, maintainable software (testing, documentation, configuration management).
* Demonstrated exposure to engineering modeling and simulation environments through academic projects, internships, or professional work (e.g., finite element analysis, computational fluid dynamics, structural or thermal analysis tools).
* Experience collaborating with domain experts (e.g., mechanical, aerospace, or systems engineers) to translate technical requirements into software.

Preferred Qualifications:

jobs.description:
Redwire is an innovative space and defense technology company driving advanced capabilities across the aerospace sector. We are looking for a leader who can contribute to concept of operations development, mission solution design, and strategic analysis for spacecraft programs supporting National Security Space. This includes work spanning space domain awareness, space resiliency, mission autonomy, structures, sensors, and next‑generation space systems.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**

Redwire’s Special Programs team is dedicated to expanding our autonomy capabilities across all domains, enhancing Space Domain Awareness, Space Situational Awareness, Command, Control, and Communications, and Modeling and Simulation. We're developing next generation multi-domain autonomy. Integrated hardware and software for air and space platforms.

**ABOUT THE JOB**

We are looking for an **Autonomy Engineer, Perception and Computer Vision** to join our rapidly growing team in **Chantilly, VA**. In this role you will be responsible for working on and influencing architecture for next generation space perception capabilities. This role will work on perception systems to include but not limited to perception tracking and navigation algorithms, flight software, AI&T, system implementation, and multidisciplinary optimization for high performance compute contexts. The autonomy engineer will work closely with other subsystems teams like Optics, Flight Software, GNC, Avionics, Mission Operations, and RF. The Autonomy Engineer will work to design algorithms, use physics based modeling for synthetic data generation

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Build, refine, and own core perception libraries and real‑time application software essential to autonomous mission systems.
* Combine classical and geometric computer vision techniques with modern machine learning to deliver robust perception and tracking capabilities.
* Develop and integrate computer vision software and hardware across spacecraft and airborne platforms, partnering closely with AI&T teams to ensure seamless implementation.
* Create software‑defined autonomy approaches that enable spacecraft to maneuver, navigate, and execute mission objectives reliably and intelligently.
* Author and execute test plans to validate perception systems from ground checkout through on‑orbit commissioning and sustained operations.
* Work across engineering disciplines to architect, implement, and verify complex features and system behaviors.
* Translate operator and customer needs into practical, high‑performance features while balancing usability with technical constraints.
* Support aggressive testing timelines, launch windows, and on‑orbit operations that demand precision and resilience.
* Design flight software, firmware, algorithms, and simulation assets that drive onboard autonomy and situational awareness.
* Build autonomy tools that support dynamic space operations, real‑time decision making, and resilient spacecraft behavior.
* Develop, refine, and run test processes that ensure system reliability across nominal and off‑nominal scenarios.
* Define automated fault‑detection logic and system responses that enhance operational safety and robustness.
* Deliver hardware‑in‑the‑loop and Monte Carlo simulation environments to evaluate system performance under realistic mission conditions.

**IDEAL QUALIFICATIONS**

* MS or PhD in Machine Learning, Robotics, Computer Science, or Image Science with a focus on Computer Vision.
* BS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field.
* Extensive hands‑on experience developing, optimizing, and benchmarking ML algorithms on large, complex datasets
* Strong proficiency in C++ on Linux‑based systems.
* Experience with one or more key perception areas: object detection, object tracking, instance or semantic segmentation, semantic change detection, or natural feature tracking (NFT).
* Background applying methods such as SLAM, multi‑view geometry, structure‑from‑motion, sensor fusion, correlation filters, or uncharacterized reconstruction to space‑ or air‑based systems.
* Familiarity with mission‑critical domains such as terminal guidance, rendezvous and docking, orbital mechanics for propulsive spacecraft, or spacecraft/missile GNC.

**DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with Python, Rust, C++, and Linux development environments.
* Motivation to engineer high‑assurance software and hardware for demanding space missions.
* Strong foundation in computer vision, navigation, image processing, SLAM, OpenCV, and NFT‑based tracking.
* Prior testing or prototyping of CV subsystems in laboratories simulating environmental conditions found in space.
* Experience with orbital mechanics and tracking of resident space objects.
* Background in spacecraft operations or satellite command and control, especially in contexts requiring high reliability and uptime.
* Hands‑on work with FlatSats, hardware‑in‑the‑loop setups, or digital simulators for validating both nominal and fault behaviors.
* Experience developing 3‑DOF and 6‑DOF dynamics simulation models for GNC analysis and verification.

Pay range

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Simulation Platform
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Simulation Platform team owns the core architecture and infrastructure of Anduril's high-fidelity, multi-domain military mission simulator. It models hundreds of entities-aircraft, ships, submarines, satellites, ground vehicles-moving, sensing, communicating, and engaging across realistic physical environments. The simulator powers training, mission planning, autonomy development, and hardware-in-the-loop testing across Anduril's product portfolio. It connects to live systems, integrates with Anduril's Lattice platform, and runs inside a GUI for interactive scenario authoring. Mission Sim is a large, mature C++20 codebase with an Entity-Component-System architecture, a stable C ABI plugin system, embedded scripting, and a variety of physics-based models. Keeping this system fast, correct, extensible, and pleasant to develop against at scale, with a growing team of model developers is our job.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Model authoring tools — an early effort you will help stand up to extend the Sim frontend with UI for authoring and tuning Mission Sim models. You will negotiate extension APIs with the GUI team and build an ergonomic UI atop them, working alongside Simulation Modeling engineers.
* Custom Entity-Component-System architecture that underpins the entire simulator: entity lifecycle, component storage, and the update loop
* Plugin and SDK development - maintaining a versioned C ABI, which enables external teams to extend the simulator
* Performance and scale — keeping the simulation loop fast enough for real-time and faster-than-real-time execution with hundreds of concurrent entities; reasoning about memory layout, cache behavior and contention, as entity counts grow
* Integration architecture — gRPC services, DIS protocol interoperability, networking messaging, and file recording for analysis and playback
* Support domain experts in integrating new and enhancing existing capability models

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 3 years of professional experience with C++20 and strong C++ skills; you should be comfortable with templates, move semantics, smart pointers, and the kinds of design decisions that show up in framework code
* Experience designing internal APIs and frameworks that other engineers build on, with focus on backwards-compatibility and ergonomics
* Solid understanding of systems programming fundamentals: memory management, shared libraries, ABI stability, linking, interfacing with the operating system
* Comfort with linear algebra and applied math
* Familiarity with Linux-based C++ development toolchains
* Ability to reason about performance-sensitive code — cache behavior, memory layout, algorithmic complexity
* Clear technical communication and ability to work in a large, shared codebase and negotiate architectural decisions that affect a growing team
* Eligibility to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Government Secret security clearance

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5+ years of professional experience with C++20
* Experience leading or mentoring engineers on a project — setting technical direction and bringing others along
* Comfort operating in ambiguity — scoping the problem, the approach, and the interfaces when none exist yet, and driving them to a decision
* Experience with military simulation, defense modeling & simulation, or related domains
* Experience with Entity-Component-System architectures or game engine design patterns
* Experience in designing and implementing GUI-supported workflows
* Familiarity with gRPC, DIS (IEEE 1278.1) distributed simulation standard
* Experience with Python/C++ interop (pybind11, embedded interpreters)
* Familiarity with behavior trees or autonomous agent architectures
* Developing in Nix
* Experience with numerical simulation, physics modeling, or scientific computing

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

**Job Description**

**Cooperative Institute for Climate, Ocean, & Ecosystem Studies (CICOES) has an outstanding opportunity for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join their team.**

  

**About this Opportunity**

Reporting to Senior Research Scientist, the Senior Software Engineer brings expertise in designing and implementing full-stack solutions for cyber-physical, embedded, and real-time systems. The successful candidate will be proficient in hardware-software integration and advanced vision systems, including deep learning, object detection, and tracking. Strong experience with embedded platforms such as Jetson Xavier/Orin, and expert in utilizing ROS for system integration. Proven ability to contribute to research and development, including technical proposals and peer-reviewed publications. Demonstrates a level head and adaptability in field research under diverse environments.

  

This is a permanent, salaried, overtime-exempt position.

**UW-CICOES**  
The Software Engineer will continuously communicate with UW scientists at CICOES to coordinate field deployments of data collection systems; lead system development, testing, and implementation efforts; and prepare field gear and equipment required for operating the KAMERA system. The Software Engineer will also collaborate with UW and CICOES scientists to plan, schedule, and execute fieldwork. As part of this fieldwork which may occur in remote and challenging Arctic environments, the Software Engineer will collaborate with UW/CICOES staff to troubleshoot technical systems; develop innovative solutions; implement, and monitor the system to ensure resolution. Outside of fieldwork, the Software Engineer will communicate with UW/CICOES staff on issues related to developing and implementing novel VIAME AI models for species detection and classification, provide biological and ecological context for model improvement, and addressing complex data processing issues such as camera misalignment and duplicate detection suppression, among others.
  
  
**Non-UW**  
In addition to coordinating activities with CICOES personnel both for fieldwork deployment and algorithm development, the Software Engineer will coordinate with external entities in order to integrate the KAMERA system (or other imaging systems) and hardware with survey aircraft, develop innovative hardware and software for uncrewed aerial systems including multi-spectral imaging systems, and developing novel state of the art AI models and cloud-based processing systems and pipelines.

In addition, colleagues from PEP will also provide feedback on engineering requirements, troubleshooting needs, camera misalignment issues, as well as the effect of weather on the performance of the KAMERA system. The Software Engineer will also collaborate with PEP colleagues to identify requirements, implement capabilities, and develop cloud-based solutions for detecting and classifying animals in imagery of varying modalities (e.g., infrared, color).

Specifically, the Software Engineer will collaborate with AOC staff to develop an intimate understanding of aircraft capabilities (power, weight, cooling, and avionics); system integration considerations (weight and balance, aviation safety, impact to platform endurance); and aviation procedures for various phases of flight as part of their design considerations while devising technological solutions and directing their integration with aircraft in coordination with AOC staff.

As a Systems Administrator Engineer III at Amazon, you will serve as a technical leader responsible for designing, operating, and improving the systems and services that keep our operations running smoothly. You will work across multiple technology domains, including operating systems, networking, hardware, and software, to solve challenging problems and deliver reliable, high-performing infrastructure. This role blends hands-on engineering with project leadership, giving you the opportunity to plan and execute technical initiatives, mentor fellow engineers, and shape the technical direction of your team while collaborating with partners across the organization.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of systems and services within your team's scope, ensuring they are highly available, performant, secure, and maintainable.
* Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across multiple technology areas, determining both short-term mitigations and long-term solutions while minimizing customer impact.

Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor-based products and coaxial and high-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive.

The Power Systems Engineer is a customer-facing technical role at the intersection of system-level power architecture and connector/cable interconnect engineering. Working directly with hyperscalers, GPU/CPU partners, infrastructure partners, and Rack Power ODMs to understand current and future power delivery architectures and turn that insight into connector and cable power solutions. The role sits between the customer's engineering teams and internal product development engineering, R&D, and applications engineering, acting as the primary technical liaison who gathers technical requirements, aligns architecture with product capability, and presents solutions back to the customer.

Power Systems Engineer works under the guidance of senior team members supporting key customers and/or key programs, while building fluency in power architecture and connector/cable technology.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Technical Requirements:** Engage with customer engineering teams to capture requirements to develop power interconnect solutions.
* **Architecture translation:** Translate system-level power architecture (e.g., 800V bus conversion, sidecar or vertical power delivery, busbar distribution) into connector and cable technology requirements to define product development.
* **Customer-facing solutioning:** Serve as the front-facing technical point of contact for power architecture discussions, presenting connector/cable solution options, trade-offs, and roadmap alignment directly to customer engineering teams.
* **Cross-functional alignment:** Partner with product engineering and manufacturing site to develop and deliver power interconnect solutions.
* **Specification development:** Develop technical requirement documents and specification inputs that drive new product development and design-in activities.
* **Design-in support:** Support qualification, validation, and design-in activities for new power interconnect solutions at customer sites.
* **Industry Standards:** Track relevant industry standards and consortia (e.g., OCP, hyperscaler-specific specifications) that shape power delivery and interconnect roadmaps.
* **Voice of customer:** Deliver customer and market insight back into internal roadmap and new product development.
* Support senior team members in customer engagements.
* Build working knowledge of the company's connector and cable product portfolio as applied to power delivery use cases.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* At minimum Bachelor of Science in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or related engineering technical field.
* Bachelor’s degree with 3+ years of experience in power connector, systems engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Master’s degree with 1+ years of experience in power connector, systems engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Foundational understanding of connector development and power architecture concepts.
* Ability to read and interpret system-level requirements and specifications.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable participating in customer-facing meetings alongside senior colleagues.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with the connector and cable industry landscape and their power interconnect product lines.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

The **Defender Experts** **Team** within Microsoft Security is building the next generation of AI-powered cybersecurity experiences. Our mission is to help customers detect, investigate, and respond to sophisticated cyber threats by combining advanced security expertise with scalable cloud services, generative AI, and intelligent agentic workflows.

We are looking for a **Principal Software Engineer** to design and build full-stack capabilities that help transform how security incidents are detected and investigated. You will work across cloud-scale backend services, APIs, large-scale security data, and AI-powered experiences, including LLM-based agents and autonomous workflows. You will tackle complex engineering problems at the intersection of distributed systems, cybersecurity, and generative AI while helping shape the architecture and technical direction of emerging products.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with software engineers, product managers, security researchers, and partner teams across Microsoft Security to turn complex security scenarios into reliable, scalable, and intuitive customer experiences. You will have opportunities to influence technical design, mentor other engineers, and help establish engineering patterns for building secure, production-ready AI capabilities.

Our team brings together people with diverse backgrounds and experiences and fosters a culture of learning, experimentation, and collaboration. If you enjoy solving ambiguous technical problems, building systems at cloud scale, and applying the latest advances in AI to meaningful cybersecurity challenges, we would love to hear from you.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Design, build, and operate highly scalable, real-time cloud services and data-processing systems using Azure technologies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of security analyst workflows.
* Develop AI-powered security capabilities using technologies such as transformer-based models, embeddings, vector stores, large language models (LLMs), and agentic workflows to solve complex security scenarios and expand automation.
* Own features end to end, from architecture and design through implementation, productization, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement in production.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers, helping establish engineering optimal practices and fostering a collaborative environment where engineers can grow, innovate, and deliver high-quality solutions.
* Lead and participate in architecture, design, and code reviews, evaluate technical approaches, apply AI-assisted software engineering practices, and improve documentation, tooling, and development practices that increase engineering efficiency and software quality.
* Collaborate across engineering, product, and security disciplines to build capabilities for both Security for AI and AI for Security, improving threat detection, investigation, and response experiences.
* Embody our culture and values.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**:

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or related technical discipline AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C#, Java, C++.

  + OR equivalent experience.

**Other Requirements:**

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Additional or Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 12+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C#, Java, C++.
  + OR Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C#, Java, C++.
  + OR equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, building, and delivering high-quality production software.
* 3+ years of experience building cloud services, distributed systems, or AI-powered systems, including experience designing and operating scalable production services.
* Experience building and shipping AI-powered features in production, using technologies such as large language models (LLMs), machine learning models, embeddings, or related AI technologies.
* Experience with machine learning frameworks and libraries, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience collaborating across engineering, product, and other technical disciplines to design and deliver complex software solutions.

jobs.description:
### **This Opportunity**

Join WSP's Energy Infrastructure Solutions – Advanced Complementary Solutions team, where we're accelerating the shift to a lower-carbon future. Our work sits at the forefront of grid-connected electrification, behind-the-meter energy systems, and power solutions across a wide range of industries.

WSP USA is seeking a **Lead Electrical Engineer** to join our Power & Energy Advanced Complementary Services (ACS) team in our **Seattle, WA** or **New York, NY** office. You will help WSP fully leverage the capabilities of all Power & Energy teams to meet critical energy challenges in the U.S. market.

Provides high-level technical assistance and guidance for multi-site/phase due diligence, investigation, remediation, impact assessment, permitting, design, development, and construction of utility, industrial, and commercial scale projects in the public and private sector. Tasks include the research, design, concept development, planning, and construction of transmission and distribution substations, power distribution, power regulation, renewable energy, as well as protection and control systems in a wide variety of contexts including utilities, transportation, buildings, and Federal, State, and local government projects. Substantiates reports and documentation to advise on materials, installations, design, component, and construction specifications. Ensures that responsibilities are delivered and adhered to with a level of quality that meets or exceeds acceptable industry standards for design, safety, and functionality.

* Lead the preparation and review of IFC electrical design documents for behind-the-meter systems from 35 kV through MV/LV distribution and device-level design, with a primary focus on charging and electrification infrastructure.
* Perform site visits and field assessments to evaluate existing electrical infrastructure, capacity, constructability, and code compliance; document findings and develop engineering recommendations.
* Serve as technical lead for utility coordination, including service applications, interconnection requirements, utility standards compliance, and coordination with utility protection and metering teams.
* Design and review:
  + MV switchgear and substations
  + Power distribution systems
  + Lighting systems and controls
  + Grounding and bonding systems
  + Lightning protection systems

### **Join Axon and be a Force for Good.**

At Axon, we're on a mission to Protect Life. We're explorers, pursuing society's most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.  
  
Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

### **Your Impact**

As a contributor in the APX platform engineering organization on the CloudNet team, you focus on solving real-time problems for mission-critical cloud-native services—and on the quality and reliability our customers expect. You'll work closely with teams operating Axon systems around the world, and your technical influence extends across engineering because every product needs sound guidance for how it connects and scales in Axon's overall networking picture. A typical week blends Kubernetes networking, service mesh (for example Istio and Envoy), ingress and gateways, TLS and certificate automation, DNS and public-edge routing, and production incidents where fixing the issue means tracing HTTP, DNS, load balancing, and cloud edges end to end. In this role, you'll ship automation and reliable cloud-based platforms (we have no data centers, so there is no rack-and-stack in this role).

**Work Location:** This role is based out of our Seattle office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success

### **What You'll Do**

* Work on a mixed infrastructure and software team that owns critical platform networking for Axon's cloud systems: mesh and ingress, TLS and certificate automation, DNS and edge routing, and the automation that keeps those paths safe and observable.
* Advance Axon's use of Istio-style service mesh patterns that underpin how we scale—building features, hardening what runs in production, and improving how we roll out change.
* Act as a builder and operator: ship infrastructure-as-code and software-backed controls, steward components that must meet strict regulatory expectations (including FedRAMP where applicable), and address vulnerabilities with timely, disciplined change.
* Advise software engineers through design reviews, ad hoc questions, and pair programming when connectivity, ingress, mesh, or TLS behavior is on the critical path.
* Automate operations so the platform stays highly available (targeting four-nines-class reliability for these components). Example: TLS certificate management and automation at scale—where small mistakes can become customer-visible outages if left manual.

### **What You Bring**

* + Six or more years working on globally diverse, 24/7, high-volume production systems.
  + Bachelors Degree in Computer Science
  + **At least one** strong track record from the following (we do not expect every candidate to match every item):
  + - Operating critical components or services in Kubernetes clusters at meaningful scale (ingress, gateways, mesh, or similar).
    - Infrastructure-as-code and automated delivery on public cloud (Axon uses Azure; other major clouds are fine).
    - Production software in Python, Go, or Java (including Scala) for infrastructure, tooling, or reliable services—not only one-off scripts.
    - Production ownership of service mesh, ingress, TLS/certificate automation, DNS or public-edge patterns, or secure east-west traffic in cloud environments.
  + Excellent problem-solving skills debugging cloud-native distributed systems (HTTP/TLS, DNS, load balancing, Kubernetes networking).
  + Familiarity with a GitOps-style approach to software and infrastructure delivery.
  + Empathy for software engineers with widely varying depth in networking—meeting people where they are, without talking past them.**Note:** This role is centered on cloud-native platform engineering and software-backed automation. It is a weaker match if your experience is primarily traditional enterprise network operations (for example campus switching or appliance-only administration) without substantial Kubernetes operations, software delivery, or infrastructure-as-code.

#### **Benefits that Benefit You**

* Competitive salary and 401k with employer match
* Discretionary paid time off
* Paid parental leave for all
* Medical, Dental, Vision plans
* Fitness Programs
* Emotional & Mental Wellness support
* Learning & Development programs
* Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)
* And yes, we have snacks in our offices

*Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.*

jobs.title: Staff Electrical Engineer, PCB Design
jobs.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form!

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by *TIME* as a “Best Invention”, *MIT Technology Review* as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and *Fast Company* as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia.

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

**Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.**

**Role Description**
--------------------

Form Energy is hiring a Staff Electrical Engineer to impact development and validation of our groundbreaking battery technology. As part of our BMS Hardware & Electrical System team, you will be responsible for the full lifecycle of PCBA design — from requirements generation, component selection, schematic & layout development,, release through vendor DFM, bring up, and verification. You will work cross-functionally with mechanical, firmware, and manufacturing teams to deliver PCBAs that meet the highest safety and compliance standards.This is an exciting opportunity to help shape and be part of the growth of a fast-moving company with breakthrough technology and an incredible mission!

*Relocation assistance is available.*

### **What you'll do:**

* Responsible for the full lifecycle of PCBA design — from requirements generation, component selection, schematic & layout development, design release through vendor DFM, bring up, verification, configuration management, sustaining
* Ensure PCBA designs meet safety, reliability, and compliance standards for high-power and hazardous systems
* Create requirements, DFMEA/CFMEA, electrical block diagrams, simulations, analysis, schematics, layouts, bring-up/test plans, and 8 Discipline (8D) reports
* Work cross functionally with System Engineering, Mechanical/Electro-Mechnical, Firmware/Software, & Test/Verification teams to define, design, & test PCBAs and resolve Electrical System related issues
* Support troubleshooting, maintenance, and continuous improvement of released PCBA designs
* Document Design Concepts, Architecture, Block Diagrams, Bring-Up/Test Results, Root Cause Investigations, and Decision Matrices

### **What you'll bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field with 7+ years of relevant experience (battery or energy storage systems experience is a plus); OR Master's degree with 5+ years of relevant experience.
* Proficiency in PCBA design ECAD SW Altium or equivalent
* Hands-on experience with sensors, power electronics (high voltage, high power, AC, SMPS, LDO), processing (MCU, MPU, SOM), networking (Ethernet, CAN-FD, isoSPI), on board communication (SPI, UART, I2C, JTAG), data acquisition (IO, ADC, DAC), and control systems (gate drivers, motor drivers, HSD)
* Strong understanding of safety and compliance considerations in high-power and/or chemical environments
* Demonstrated experience designing PCBAs and Electrical Systems to UL 991, 1973, 9540, 1998 requirements
* Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance speed, rigor, and safety
* Familiarity with the SW including PLM (e.g. Arena or Team Center), product development SW (e.g. JIRA) and requirement management tools (e.g. JAMA)
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently and cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment

*#LI-Onsite*

*Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here.*

*When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.*

*To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.*

*If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.*  
  
*Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will* ***never*** *solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.*

Compensation Range: $147,959 - $194,218

**Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.**

**Role Description**
--------------------

Form Energy is hiring a Staff Control Panel Designer to impact development and validation of our groundbreaking battery technology. As part of our BMS Hardware & Electrical System team, you will be responsible for the full lifecycle of industrial control panel design — from component selection and schematic development through vendor coordination and high-voltage validation. You will work cross-functionally with mechanical, electrical, and manufacturing teams to deliver panels that meet the highest safety and compliance standards.This is an exciting opportunity to help shape and be part of the growth of a fast-moving company with breakthrough technology and an incredible mission!

*Relocation assistance is available.*

### **What you'll do:**

* Design the control panel panels in compliance with NEC (NFPA 70) and UL 508A standards
* Develop complete control panel schematic, layout and BOM using EPLAN
* Select appropriate control panel components including connectors, wire harnesses, branch circuit protection devices (breakers, fuses), and power conversion devices (drives, transformers, rectifiers)
* Select components rated for 600V AC and 2000V DC high-voltage applications
* Work directly with third-party panel vendors to translate design intent into built assemblies.
* Execute and oversee high-voltage testing procedures including hipot, insulation resistance, and functional validation
* Collaborate with mechanical engineers on panel enclosure selection, thermal management, and physical integration
* Support DFMEA activities for panel-level failure mode identification and risk mitigation

### **What you'll bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field with 7+ years of relevant experience; OR Master's degree with 5+ years of relevant experience
* Proficiency in panel design SW EPLAN or equivalent
* Demonstrated experience designing panels to NEC and UL 508A requirements
* Hands-on experience in testing with high-voltage testing procedures and associated safety protocols
* Strong working knowledge of branch protection coordination, wire sizing, and power conversion device integration
* Experience managing third-party panel fabrication vendors through design, build, and acceptance phases
* Familiarity with the SW including PLM (e.g. Arena or Team Center), product development SW (e.g. JIRA) and requirement management tools (e.g. JAMA)
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently and cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment

jobs.title: Staff Hardware Engineer
jobs.description:
**We believe power is a promise - a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most.**
====================================================================================================

For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future.

Ready to Power a Smarter World with us?

The Staff Hardware Engineer serves as a senior technical leader responsible for the architecture, design, integration, validation, and lifecycle support of complex embedded electronic hardware systems used across Generac products. This role leads new product development initiatives involving embedded controls, power electronics, analog and digital circuitry, and microprocessor-based systems. The position provides technical leadership across multiple engineering disciplines, drives innovation and continuous improvement, ensures compliance with quality and regulatory requirements, and mentors engineering talent while delivering solutions that meet performance, reliability, manufacturability, schedule, and cost objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the architecture, design, integration, verification, and validation of complex embedded electronic hardware systems for new product development and technology initiatives.
* Define system and hardware requirements, design specifications, verification plans, and acceptance criteria while maintaining traceability throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Provide technical leadership for complex programs involving multiple subsystems, ensuring achievement of quality, performance, schedule, and cost objectives.
* Lead hardware design activities involving microprocessors, microcontrollers, analog and digital circuitry, communication interfaces, and power electronics technologies.
* Drive design reviews, component selection, DFMEA/FMEA activities, risk assessments, root-cause investigations, and resolution of complex technical issues.
* Collaborate with firmware, software, mechanical, manufacturing, sourcing, supplier quality, and operations teams to optimize product performance, reliability, manufacturability, and cost.
* Serve as the technical authority for hardware architecture, EMC compliance, regulatory requirements, and engineering standards while mentoring and developing engineers.
* Advance engineering effectiveness through continuous improvement initiatives, development of testing and validation strategies, and evaluation of emerging technologies.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related Engineering discipline.
* Seven (7)+ years of experience designing analog and digital electronic systems, including leadership of complex product development programs involving multiple subsystems and cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated expertise in analog and digital circuit design, including microprocessors, microcontrollers, communication protocols, hardware interfaces, and embedded electronic systems.
* Advanced knowledge of power electronics, hardware architecture development, system-level design, and complex system integration.
* Proven ability to lead large-scale embedded controls or power electronics development programs, providing technical leadership, engineering direction, and sound technical decision-making.
* Expertise in engineering processes and methodologies including design reviews, DFMEA/FMEA, root-cause analysis, continuous improvement practices, EMC compliance, and engineering best practices.
* Experience utilizing schematic capture and PCB design tools (e.g., Altium Designer) and reviewing layouts for signal integrity, electromagnetic compatibility, manufacturability, and reliability.
* Working knowledge of applicable regulatory and product safety standards, including UL, CSA, IEC, FCC, and CE, with demonstrated success collaborating with suppliers, customers, contract manufacturers, and cross-functional business teams.
* Strong business and technical acumen, including experience developing technology roadmaps, evaluating emerging technologies, managing product lifecycle considerations, mentoring engineering talent, and understanding engineering’s impact on product cost and business performance.

**Great Reasons to work for Generac**:

* Competitive Benefits: Health, Dental, Vision, 401k and many more
* Scheduled events throughout the year that allow our employees, both current and retirees, to gather together and enjoy their time with their families and co-workers
* Pride! When a storm strikes, Generac employees always rise to the occasion. Each time a storm hits, many employees volunteer their time with the customer support team or on the production line, while others go right into storm-affected areas to repair generators
* Make a positive impact. Generac has always been community-minded and dedicated to giving back. The company proudly offers a Volunteer Time Off program, inviting team members to participate in charitable volunteer opportunities on company time.
